papers.title: SAM3D-Guided Object-Centric Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Zonghe Liu, Shanyuan Jie, Xiaoquan Sun, Chen Cao, Zetian Xu, Zongsheng Liu, Jiayu Chen
papers.summary: 现有 VLA 模型多依赖 2D vision-language backbone，在遮挡、尺度变化和精确空间交互时缺少物体级 3D 理解。论文在 π0 上加入 object-centric 3D representation alignment：先定位任务物体并生成 mask，再用 frozen SAM3D teacher 提取 dense object-level 3D 表示，监督中间视觉特征。推理时不需要深度、点云、mask、SAM3D 或额外 3D 模块，因此保持原始 RGB-language-to-action 管线。LIBERO、CALVIN 和真实长程操作实验都显示该几何监督对目标切换和空间交互有明显帮助。
methodHighlights: frozen SAM3D 3D teacher
object-centric dense alignment
test-time 纯 RGB-language-action 推理

papers.title: HiFi-UMI: Learning Deployable Manipulation Policies from High-Fidelity UMI Data Alone
papers.authors: Simple AI, Yuteng Wei, Jinming Ma, Jiawei Wang, Weitao Zhou, Yushen Zuo, Ke Rui, Minglei Li, Jinhao Zhang, Zhikang Pan, Xiang Wang, Haoran Jia, Huan Du, Zicheng Zeng, Jun Ma, Guiyu Qin, Di Zhang, Xiaofei Li
papers.summary: HiFi-UMI 重新设计 robot-free 数据生产链路：头戴式离线 stereo-inertial SLAM、原生 inter-gripper relative pose、微秒级同步触发和双手广角相机，让轨迹和视野精度接近部署需求。论文展示了 zero-robot post-training：只用 HiFi-UMI demonstrations 后训练的策略可以直接部署到真实机器人。结果说明，提升 robot-free 数据保真度可能比继续混入少量真实机器人 anchor 更有杠杆。
methodHighlights: high-fidelity UMI capture
3 mm workspace-local end-effector accuracy
zero-robot post-training across VLA/WAM backbones

papers.title: DC-WAM: Dynamic-Centric Visual Supervision and Reasoning for World-Action Models
papers.authors: Haoyuan Ji, Lingxiang Fan, Shang Su, Yinqiao Lu, Mengkai Shi, Jun Gao, Shuo Feng
papers.summary: DC-WAM 重新分配 RGB 视频分支的监督与计算，让 world-action model 更关注由动作导致的视觉动态。它用 temporal-difference flow matching 和 trajectory-guided weighting 强化 gripper、物体和接触区域的变化，再用 DynaRoute 给动态相关 token 加 attention bias。这个方向把 world-action model 从“看起来像未来”推进到“学到对控制有用的未来”。
methodHighlights: dynamic-centric future visual supervision
trajectory-guided weighting
DynaRoute token-wise dynamic attention bias

papers.title: INTACT: Isomorphic Intent-to-Action Learning for Search-Free World Models
papers.authors: Junhan Sun, Hao Zhao, Guofeng Zhang
papers.summary: INTACT 把 action-labeled、reward-free trajectories 转成 intent-to-action interface，用 JEPA 风格的 latent intent 表示连接局部 transition intent 和 future goal intent。它通过 isomorphic local/goal grammar、shared parameters 和 asymmetric endpoint gradients，把表示学习和控制对齐到可直接采样的 action law。官方 LeWM 任务上，zero-search 模型已经能给出很强成功率，说明搜索不一定是 latent world model 控制接口的必需品。
methodHighlights: search-free intent-to-action JEPA
isomorphic local/goal motion-intent grammar
direct distributional action law

papers.title: SONG: A Photorealistic 3D Gaussian Simulation Platform for Benchmarking Social Navigation
papers.authors: Weiqi Huang, Dianyi Yang, Jiaxin Li, Shuangyi Dong, Hao Xu, Zan Wang, Wei Liang
papers.summary: SONG 用 3D Gaussian Splatting 同时表示场景和 avatar，并用 LLM 生成语义化行人轨迹，再由轨迹条件 motion generator 合成自然行人动作。它还构建 SONG-Bench，把导航效果、安全性和社会合规性拆开评估。论文的核心价值是把 photorealistic 3D representation 引入 embodied social navigation 基准，而不是只做静态新视角合成。
methodHighlights: 3DGS scene/avatar simulation
LLM-grounded pedestrian trajectories
effectiveness/safety/social-compliance metric suite

papers.title: Wonder: Video World Model Done Better
papers.authors: Jiacong Xu, Hanwen Jiang, Zhixin Shu, Kalyan Sunkavalli, Vishal M. Patel, Yiqun Mei
papers.summary: Wonder 面向实时、可控相机的 video world model：给定图片或条件视频后，用户可以交互式移动相机、探索未见区域并回访已见区域。系统用 dense coordinate field 做 camera conditioning，把运动和方向 cue 直接渲染为空间对齐的视觉证据，并用 sparse attention memory 支持长程上下文检索。对于三维生成和可交互 world model，这篇工作值得关注其“控制接口 + 长程记忆 + 实时生成”的系统设计。
methodHighlights: dense coordinate field camera conditioning
sparse attention memory
rectified self-forcing distillation for long rollouts

papers.title: PanoLess: Environment Reconstruction from Partial Reflective Views
papers.authors: Ahitagni Das, Ashok Veeraraghavan, Vivek Boominathan
papers.summary: PanoLess 用 surface-aligned 2D Gaussian splats 先恢复 normal、albedo、depth 等 buffer，再通过反射方向查询 neural cubemap 来重建环境图。它额外输出 visibility map，标明哪些环境方向真正受观测约束，减少 partial-view 场景里的幻觉。该工作对机器人从偶然反射、镜面和玻璃中恢复隐藏环境也有启发。
methodHighlights: surface-aligned 2D Gaussian splats
neural cubemap environment map
visibility map for partial reflective observations

papers.title: Transformer Transformer: A Unified Model for Motion-Conditioned Robot Co-design
papers.authors: Huy Ha, C. Karen Liu, Shuran Song
papers.summary: Transformer Transformer 把 robot embodiment、state 和 action 统一 token 化为 RoboTokens，并训练 diffusion transformer 在不同 embodiment space 中生成机器人设计和控制器。模型不绑定单一 reward，而是作为 dynamics model，通过 Dynamics Self-Guidance 把 reward-specific value 反馈到 embodiment diffusion。论文还制造了优化后的 ALOHA 设计，展示了从生成式 co-design 到实体机器人的闭环。
methodHighlights: RoboTokens unified tokenization
motion-conditioned embodiment diffusion
Dynamics Self-Guidance for reward-specific design

papers.title: πR^2: Reactive Real-time Flow Policies
papers.authors: Sungjae Park, Shubham Tulsiani
papers.summary: πR^2 把 action-chunking flow policy 的 conditioning 拆成快速通道和慢速通道：proprioception 可每个 tick 更新，vision-language feature 异步更新并允许滞后。它还把 in-flight actions 当作 inpainting conditioning，用 latency-adaptive flow schedule 单步输出后续动作。该设计对实时机器人操作尤其关键，因为它试图保留大模型策略能力，同时恢复闭环反应性。
methodHighlights: fast proprioception / slow vision-language channels
latency-adaptive flow schedule
one-step reactive action emission

papers.title: Amortising Trajectory Optimisation for Residual MPC via Implicit Contact Differentiation
papers.authors: Daniel Layeghi, Thomas Corberes, Calum Arnott, Aditya Kamireddypalli, Hashim Al-Obaidi, Steve Tonneau, Michael Mistry
papers.summary: 论文在 MuJoCo MJX 中实现 AD-assisted implicit derivative，对 tolerance-converged contact solution 的 stationarity residual 应用 IFT 求导，避免 unroll 和手工 KKT。它进一步用 optimizer distillation 把 full-horizon iLQR 摊销成 policy，再指导 short-horizon residual iLQR。对于 Physical AI 来说，这是一条把可微接触、MPC 和策略学习连接起来的实用路线。
methodHighlights: IFT-based implicit contact derivative
constant-ish compiled memory vs unrolled AD
optimizer distillation for residual MPC

papers.title: Track-Leakage-Free Hold-Out Self-Validation for Photogrammetric Reconstruction: Protocol, Sensitivity, and Limits
papers.authors: Behnam Asadi
papers.summary: 论文提出 track-leakage-free hold-out protocol：保留部分图像，再只用至少被两个保留图像观测过的 3D points 做 re-localization，避免测试视图用到自己贡献的结构。实验表明这个自一致信号能检查内部几何一致性，但会饱和，且对 coherent global distortion 不敏感。它提醒三维重建系统不能把 self-consistency 当作 absolute accuracy 或通用失败检测器。
methodHighlights: track-level leakage barrier
hold-out re-localization confidence
negative result on self-consistency saturation

papers.title: S2A2: Audio-Visual Imitation Learning for Manipulation Tasks Using Acoustic Spatial Information
papers.authors: Kaneyoshi Hiratsuka, Benjamin Yen, Ryosuke Kojima
papers.summary: S2A2 设计 acoustic-aware manipulation tasks，要求机器人通过声音定位或识别操作目标，并提出 Spatial-Spectral Audio Action 框架把视觉特征、声源空间信息和声学信号融合进 imitation policy。作者把 ACT、Diffusion Policy、VQ-BeT 和 π0 等策略接入该框架，在仿真和真实机器人上验证了 position + timbre 场景下的收益。
methodHighlights: acoustic-aware manipulation tasks
spatial-spectral audio action fusion
plug-in wrapper for ACT / Diffusion Policy / VQ-BeT / π0

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-28
reports.summary: 最新官方批次筛出 10 篇相关论文；embodied data、world models、3D 表示和 HOI 是主线。
trends: embodied data 正在从单一数据集转向“数据配方”思路：Data Pyramid 把 real-robot、UMI、egocentric/exocentric、simulation 和 general VLM 数据放到同一框架里比较。
world model 更强调触觉、动作和 latent 规划的分工：DeVA、FeelWorld、WorldDiT 和 LeapBot-WA 都在降低“先像素、后控制”的耦合。
3D 表示继续往 feed-forward 和 compact latent 收缩：GenSplatCodec、MSVS-VAE 和 NSL-SLAM 分别从压缩、重建和深度三条线追求可部署性。
HOI 与 articulated manipulation 正在回到显式结构：KAI 和 Real-Time Human-Centric World Modeling for Upper-Body Human-Object Interaction 都把运动学或交互状态放回控制接口。
重点作者/团队本批次未见 Kaiming He、Anpei Chen、Shangzhe Wu、Qianqian Wang、Saining Xie 或 Oxford VGG / Visual Geometry Group 的精确命中。
topPapers: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
FeelWorld: Visuo-Tactile World Model for Hierarchical Contact Prediction and Planning
KAI: A Kinematic-Aware Interface for Data-Efficient Articulated Object Manipulation
GenSplatCodec: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting Compression via One-Step Diffusion
MSVS-VAE: Multi-Scale Anchored VecSet for High-Fidelity 3D Reconstruction
NSL-SLAM: High-Fidelity Neural Structured-Light Depth for Practical SLAM and Reconstruction
Real-Time Human-Centric World Modeling for Upper-Body Human-Object Interaction
WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
LeapBot-WA: World-Anchor Action Models via Predictive Latent Alignments

papers.title: Data Pyramid for Embodied Manipulation
papers.authors: Yifan Ye, Yankai Fu, Yaoxu Lv, Bohan Hou, Jun Cen, Lingdong Kong, Duo Zheng, Tianxing Chen, Jiaming Liu, Ziang Cao, Yunfan Lou, Wei Chow, Xian Sun, Yingshuo Wang, Kuangzhi Ge, Xiaowei Chi, Xidong Zhang, Zhibo Pang, Yiwu Zhong, Sirui Han, Zhihe Lu, Weihao Yuan, Qifeng Chen, Michael Yu Wang, Yao Mu, Ziwei Liu, Jianfei Yang, Ping Luo, Shanghang Zhang
papers.summary: Embodied agents 不能像网页视觉模型那样直接吞下全网数据，因为它们需要把观察和物理状态、动作绑在一起。论文把 embodied data 组织成五类互补来源：real-robot、UMI-style、egocentric/exocentric、simulation 和 general vision-language data。作者进一步从数据质量、多样性、可复用性和物理保真度几个维度分析数据配方如何影响感知、推理、规划、动作生成和 world prediction，并总结了 6 个开放问题。
methodHighlights: 五源 embodied data pyramid
数据 recipe 与能力映射分析
六个开放挑战

papers.title: DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
papers.authors: Mengqi Zhang, Sahil Khose, Simar Kareer, Yuchen Song, Unnat Jain, Judy Hoffman
papers.summary: 通用机器人操作需要预判视觉场景在执行语言指令时如何变化。DeVA 把视频分支和动作分支解耦成两个专家，再把多层视频特征转移到动作分支，同时用 affordance 和 depth 这类物理显著信号监督中间表征。论文显示，这种做法比统一式 backbone 更容易优化，也能在仿真和真实部署中更快收敛、以更少数据获得更好表现。
methodHighlights: decoupled video-action experts
multi-level feature transfer
physically salient guidance (affordance/depth)

papers.title: FeelWorld: Visuo-Tactile World Model for Hierarchical Contact Prediction and Planning
papers.authors: Wenxuan Ma, Chaofan Zhang, Chao Xue, Yinghao Cai, Guocai Yao, Shaowei Cui, Shuo Wang
papers.summary: 视觉 world model 往往能想象外观变化，却很难表达接触状态，而触觉正是 contact-rich 任务里的关键变量。FeelWorld 把 contact state、3D tactile latent 和 slip state 组织成层次化状态，并用共享 latent dynamics 联合预测未来视觉和触觉。它再配合 contact-gated asymmetric attention、autoregressive rollouts 和 context noise injection，让模型在长时序滚动时更稳，并支持接触感知的规划。
methodHighlights: hierarchical visuo-tactile state space
contact-gated asymmetric attention
contact-aware CEM planning

papers.title: KAI: A Kinematic-Aware Interface for Data-Efficient Articulated Object Manipulation
papers.authors: Yaping Li, Zhaxizhuoma, Qiaojun Yu, Jia Zeng, Dahua Lin, Jiangmiao Pang
papers.summary: articulated object manipulation 难点不只是看清物体，而是抓住它的运动学结构。KAI 引入一个 kinematic-aware interface 作为中间表示，把几何和运动学先验塞进策略学习流程。这样做能显著提升样本效率，在较少示范下仍维持高成功率，并且还能用人类交互视频做 co-training 来增强真实场景泛化。
methodHighlights: kinematic-aware intermediate interface
geometric + kinematic priors
action-agnostic video co-training

papers.title: GenSplatCodec: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting Compression via One-Step Diffusion
papers.authors: Qiang Hu, Zhenlong Wu, Lei Huang, Zihan Zheng, Xiaoyun Zhang, Wenjun Zhang
papers.summary: feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting 虽然避免了逐场景优化，但生成的高斯体积太大，不利于存储和传输。GenSplatCodec 把低比特率压缩重新表述为 geometry-guided generative decoding，用双流结构-外观编码器和一阶生成解码器重建视角一致的高质量高斯表示。它的重点不只是压缩率，而是把重建结构和生成细节放在同一个 codec 里协同优化。
methodHighlights: dual-stream Gaussian codec
geometry-guided one-step decoding
three-stage optimization

papers.title: MSVS-VAE: Multi-Scale Anchored VecSet for High-Fidelity 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Dehao Hao, Kaiyi Zhang, Tanghui Jia, Xiangjun Gao, Dongyu Yan, Weikai Chen, Zeyu Hu, Lingting Zhu, Yingda Yin, Runze Zhang, Li Yuan, Xin Wang, Long Quan
papers.summary: 高保真 3D 生成模型越来越受底层 3D VAE 质量制约。MSVS-VAE 仍然保持 set-based latent 的紧凑性，但通过 hierarchical point-shuffle upsampling 逐步加密 latent，再用局部几何聚合解码把细节补回来。结果是它在保持 compact 的前提下显著提升了重建质量，接近甚至超过更重的 voxel-based VAE。
methodHighlights: hierarchical VecSet densification
AVS-Conv local aggregation
multi-scale query decoding

papers.title: NSL-SLAM: High-Fidelity Neural Structured-Light Depth for Practical SLAM and Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jiaheng Li, Binsheng Zhang, Xinhai Chang, Wenzheng Chen
papers.summary: structured-light 摄像头已经很普遍，但真正可部署的 SLAM 还需要更稳的深度和更简单的系统设计。NSL-SLAM 先用更强的 neural structured-light depth 提升深度质量，再把深度作为主跟踪信号，只在几何退化时加入少量视觉对应和轻量 BA。它在合成和真实场景上都给出更稳的轨迹和更好的重建结果，同时还能在线运行。
methodHighlights: stronger neural structured-light depth
depth-centric SLAM pipeline
sparse correspondences + lightweight BA

papers.title: Real-Time Human-Centric World Modeling for Upper-Body Human-Object Interaction
papers.authors: Chaonan Ji, Jinwei Qi, Peng Zhang, Bang Zhang
papers.summary: HOI 生成正在从“让人和物一起动”走向“显式控制交互状态”。这篇工作把连续的人体状态和离散的交互状态分开建模：前者用多尺度 motion latent 融合上半身、手和脸，后者用语言编码的离散状态表示 no contact、grasp 这类交互命令。系统最终还能蒸馏成实时流式推理，在细粒度手-物协调上比单纯动作复现更实用。
methodHighlights: continuous/discrete joint control
multi-scale motion encoding
language-encoded interaction states

papers.title: WorldDiT: A Unified Diffusion Architecture for World and Action Modeling
papers.authors: Sen Wang, R. Gnana Praveen, Bidhan Roy, Marcos Villagra
papers.summary: 许多机器人 world model 仍然依赖大规模预训练 VLM 作为动作骨干，但这会抬高参数和训练复杂度。WorldDiT 用一个统一的 diffusion transformer 同时生成 action chunks 和未来 RGB patch 预测，把世界建模和控制目标压到同一个 backbone 里。它在 LIBERO 系列任务上给出了很强的参数-成功率折中，适合作为后续 scaling study 的轻量基线。
methodHighlights: unified diffusion world-action model
action chunk + future RGB prediction
parameter-efficient baseline

papers.title: LeapBot-WA: World-Anchor Action Models via Predictive Latent Alignments
papers.authors: Pei Liu, Nan Zheng, Lang Zhang, Daojie Peng, Yanan Zhang, Feilong Kong, Mingyue Feng, Jiachao Liu, Yaonong Wang, Qifeng Chen, Jun Ma
papers.summary: 生成式 world-action model 很容易把算力浪费在重建任务无关的像素细节上。LeapBot-WA 把核心表示切到 latent predictive space，用 JEPA 风格的 world anchor 表达抽象物理动态，再用 isotropic semantic autoencoder 和 asymmetric MoT 把 latent 空间整形成更适合 diffusion 的流形。训练时有 privileged dynamics expert 帮忙，推理时这条分支可以裁掉，因此既高效又更稳。
methodHighlights: predictive latent world-anchor
ISAE manifold shaping
asymmetric MoT with prunable dynamics expert

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-27
reports.summary: 最新官方批次筛出 10 篇相关论文；3D 表示、world models、HOI 和几何感知导航是主线。
trends: 3D 表示继续从‘能渲染’走向‘会分配、会变形、会约束’：semantic Gaussian allocation 直接处理预算分配，deformable triangle splatting 则把原语从凸边界扩展到可变形非凸形状。
world model 更明显地向机器人本体和接触几何靠拢：Robot-Factored World Models 把 action realization 和 robot rendering 拆出去，ViTacWorld 则把触觉作为 contact-rich manipulation 的核心观测。
HOI 不再只是识别，而是在做生成和重建：AgentHOI 生成人-物交互视频，Time-Reversed Imaging 则从残留痕迹反推‘刚刚发生了什么’。
几何约束仍是导航、定位和物理推断的底层接口：SM4RT、Visual Relocalization、JustDepth 和 SiPhy 分别把 4D 运动、低纹理定位、雷达-相机深度和单图物理属性推断拉回几何空间。
重点作者/团队精确命中：未发现 Kaiming He、Anpei Chen、Shangzhe Wu、Qianqian Wang、Saining Xie 或 Oxford VGG / Visual Geometry Group 的本批次精确命中。
topPapers: Robot-Factored World Models via Robot Rendering
ViTacWorld: Scaling Visuo-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
Learning Adaptive Semantic Gaussian Allocation for 3D Occupancy
Deformable Triangle Splatting: Flexible Primitives for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
SM4RT: Learning Structured Motion Geometry for 4D Reconstruction
SiPhy: Single-Image Physical Property Reasoning
AgentHOI: Multi-Agent Reasoning for Human-Object-Interaction Video Generation via Implicit Representation Alignment
Visual Relocalization from Sparse Views in Aliased and Low-Texture Environments via Novel View Synthesis
Time-Reversed Imaging: A Multimodal Benchmark and Framework for Reconstructing Past Human-Environment Interactions
JustDepth: Real-Time Radar-Camera Depth Estimation with Single-Scan LiDAR Supervision

papers.title: Robot-Factored World Models via Robot Rendering
papers.authors: Byungjun Kim, Taeksoo Kim, Hyunsoo Cha, Hanbyul Joo
papers.summary: 这篇工作把动作与环境响应拆开，避免 world model 同时学习 action realization 和 contact outcome。作者先把命令经由机器人控制器和运动学变成可部署的 nominal trajectory，再用 URDF 把机器人几何显式渲染进模型。再配合 end-effector depth 和 scene depth，模型在未见过的机器人形态上也能更稳地泛化，并能把人类示范重定向成机器人操作视频。
methodHighlights: action realization 外置
robot rendering 显式编码机器人几何
双深度线索缓解 contact/occlusion 歧义

papers.title: ViTacWorld: Scaling Visuo-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Yunao Huang, Shiyu Sang, Haotao Lu, Suting Ni, Shijie Wu, Ziyang Guo, Ye Shi, Jingya Wang
papers.summary: 接触丰富的操作任务里，视觉常常看不见真正的接触状态，触觉就成了关键补充。ViTacWorld 把 public tactile data 与构造的仿真环境结合起来，先做大规模 real+sim visuo-tactile 预训练，再用真实策略 rollout 微调。作者希望借此把触觉信号从“小众硬件特例”变成可规模化的 world model 输入。
methodHighlights: action-conditioned visuo-tactile world model
real+sim 大规模轨迹预训练
真实 rollout 微调增强接触控制

papers.title: Learning Adaptive Semantic Gaussian Allocation for 3D Occupancy
papers.authors: Kanglin Ning, Yiran Zhao, Wenrui Li, Houde Quan, Qifan Li, Xingtao Wang, Xiaopeng Fan
papers.summary: Semantic 3D Gaussians 很紧凑，但在固定预算下怎么把容量分给真正困难的区域，一直没有被直接处理。SAGFormer 用 Gaussian 属性和局部几何-语义特征评估“该把哪些 Gaussians 留给谁”，从而在内存和算力受限时更合理地分配表示。结果是 occupancy 预测不再只靠更复杂的原语形状或初始化，而是把“预算分配”本身变成核心模块。
methodHighlights: budget-aware Gaussian allocation
Gaussian 属性 + 局部几何语义打分
固定资源下提升 3D occupancy 表达效率

papers.title: Deformable Triangle Splatting: Flexible Primitives for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
papers.authors: Oriol Jiménez-Ayguadé, Antonio Agudo
papers.summary: 三角形原语比 2D 高斯更贴近表面，但对凹/非凸结构仍然不够灵活。Deformable Triangle Splatting 给每条边加可学习位移，把原始三角形变成可变形的非凸原语，同时仍保持稳定的 3D 平面参数化。它在 barycentric 空间里做可微栅格化，并用 winding number 判断像素是否落入变形原语，从而兼顾实时性和几何表达力。
methodHighlights: per-edge learnable deformation
barycentric rasterization + winding number
面向实时 radiance field 的非凸原语

papers.title: SM4RT: Learning Structured Motion Geometry for 4D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Shing Ho J. Lin, Wenzhao Zheng, Dong Zhuo, Yuqi Wu, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 4D reconstruction 里的 motion 从“点级位移”改写成“结构化运动几何”。SM4RT 认为真实物体更接近 SE(3) 级别的刚体变换，因此引入 Structure-of-Motion 表示来同时学习场景动力学和 3D 重建。它把几何基础模型的单目重建能力往动态理解和物理运动上推了一步。
methodHighlights: Structured Motion 4D Reconstruction Transformer
以 SE(3) 组织动态而非点位移
重建与运动感知联合建模

papers.title: SiPhy: Single-Image Physical Property Reasoning
papers.authors: Hoang Le, Joonwoo Kwon, Elkhan Ismayilzada, Yufei Zhang, Zijun Cui
papers.summary: 单张图像里反推出质量、刚度、弹性，直接面向 simulation 和 embodied AI 所需的物理属性。SiPhy 从 RGB 图像采样 pseudo-voxel points，再用 CLIP 特征和 VLM 提出的材料候选做对齐，最后用 part-based contrastive aggregator 和 heaviness-aware refinement 细化厚度与体积估计。它的重点不是生成漂亮的 3D，而是把 3D-aware 线索、深度和语言材料知识拧成一个可用于物理推断的框架。
methodHighlights: pseudo-voxel + CLIP + VLM 材料 grounding
part-based contrastive aggregation
heaviness-aware refinement

papers.title: AgentHOI: Multi-Agent Reasoning for Human-Object-Interaction Video Generation via Implicit Representation Alignment
papers.authors: Ziyao Huang, Shunkai Li, Juan Cao, Chenyu Li, Youliang Zhang, Zixiang Zhou, Cong Wang, Yuan Zhou, Qinglin Lu, Fan Tang
papers.summary: HOI video generation 不只是“让人和物同时动起来”，而是要把交互逻辑讲清楚。AgentHOI 先用 multi-agent reasoning 对 perception、interaction 和 motion planning 做思考，再把生成计划送入扩散模型。它进一步通过 implicit text-motion alignment 把 text-to-motion 先验蒸馏进视频生成器，减少对显式运动控制的依赖。
methodHighlights: thinking-before-generation
多智能体交互/规划推理
implicit text-motion alignment

papers.title: Time-Reversed Imaging: A Multimodal Benchmark and Framework for Reconstructing Past Human-Environment Interactions
papers.authors: Jorge Bacca, Kebin Contreras, Luis Toscano-Palomino, Mauro Dalla Mura
papers.summary: 这篇工作把问题反过来：不是预测未来，而是从残留痕迹推回“刚刚发生了什么”。TRACE-HEI 数据集把热红外、紫外和可见光三模态串起来，覆盖坐、摸、搬动物体、液体泼洒等人-环境交互，并延迟到接触后三分钟。方法上，它先把痕迹转成结构化文本，再用 VLM 引导的 diffusion model 复原过去帧，比较像交互取证而不是传统 video prediction。
methodHighlights: TRACE-HEI 多模态 benchmark
痕迹文本化再约束扩散复原
面向人-环境交互回溯

papers.title: Visual Relocalization from Sparse Views in Aliased and Low-Texture Environments via Novel View Synthesis
papers.authors: Maria Peribañez, Javier Civera, Rudolph Triebel, Riccardo Giubilato
papers.summary: 低纹理、强歧义、弱重叠视角会让传统匹配式定位很快失效，尤其是在 rover 场景里。这个方法用 3D Gaussian Splatting 构建可微地图，再用 photometric + geometric losses 联合训练，其中几何监督来自 MVS 和 LiDAR 深度。它把 relocalization 直接绑到几何表示上，对地外/野外导航这类场景很有针对性。
methodHighlights: 3DGS 可微地图
photometric + geometric 联合训练
MVS/LiDAR 深度监督的低纹理定位

papers.title: JustDepth: Real-Time Radar-Camera Depth Estimation with Single-Scan LiDAR Supervision
papers.authors: Wooyung Yun, Dongwook Kim, Soomok Lee
papers.summary: 雷达+相机深度估计的痛点是既要低延迟，又要保住 metric scale。JustDepth 把 radar returns 压成固定宽度表示，用 Height Fusion Block 融合模态，再配一个轻量 GNN 做全局传播，训练阶段再加 confidence decoder，但测试时不增加开销。作者还提出 VHGR 指标来量化条纹伪影，说明他们不仅在追精度，也在追可部署性。
methodHighlights: 固定宽度 radar 表示
Height Fusion Block + lightweight GNN
VHGR 条纹伪影指标

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-23
reports.summary: 最近一个官方批次筛选出 31 篇相关论文；3DGS/占用、具身 world models、机器人操作与导航系统是主线。
trends: 今天最强的三维视觉主线是 3DGS/几何表示继续向可编辑、可评估、可部署前馈系统推进：ATSplat 做自适应前馈 3DGS，LB-Edit 处理多视图编辑一致性，MR-Compare 把 3DGS 与 mesh 放到 mixed reality 中做现场对齐评估，GaussianSeed 则把 Gaussian hierarchy 用于高分辨率 3D occupancy。

world/action model 明显更重视几何落地和可执行性：KineBench 用 6D end-effector pose 和 simulator 闭环验证 embodied world models，PerceptDrive 强调 perception priors 到 planning 的路由，SafeGen 用 depth-aware projection 生成安全关键驾驶视频，Koopman Dreamer 用谱约束稳定长 horizon latent imagination。
机器人操作方向集中在从人类数据和语言条件中获得可执行几何动作：HOST 从单个 human video 快速获取技能，SeededGrasp 让 VLM 预测 seed point 再交给抓取生成器，EgoRecovery 用 egocentric recovery data 学失败恢复，LENS 则把 clutter scene 简化成任务相关抽象。
导航和 humanoid 方向从 benchmark 走向真实部署：NavVerse 补齐 indoor-to-outdoor 连续导航，Milo 给出低成本导盲犬平台，DEED 和 miniature humanoid tele-loco-manipulation 都强调 VLA/VR/RL 在真实人形机器人中的系统集成。
最值得深入阅读的是 ATSplat、Crowd4D、KineBench、PerceptDrive、SeededGrasp、HOST、LENS、StreamHOI、GaussianSeed 和 StereoFlow。它们共同显示出一个趋势：三维表示正在从视觉重建结果变成生成、评测、规划和机器人闭环控制共享的中间状态。

PerceptDrive: Perception Prior World-Action Modeling with Adaptive Expert Routing for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

GaussianSeed: Hierarchical Gaussian Seeding for High-Resolution 3D Occupancy Prediction
STEREOFLOW: Progressive Stereo Matching with StereoDiT and Transition Flow Matching

papers.title: ModPack: An Extensible Teleoperation Interface for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Joshua Citron, Renee Zbizika, Zeyi Liu, Shuran Song
papers.summary: ModPack 是面向双臂移动操作的模块化遥操作系统，目标是降低不同机器人平台之间的数据采集和策略学习成本。它把计算、电源、通信和存储封装成可穿戴 backpack，并在其上插接关节级遥操作、触觉反馈、移动操作和主动感知模块。对机器人操作研究而言，这类可复用的遥操作硬件/软件栈比单一任务 demo 更有价值，因为它直接影响大规模真实数据采集。论文在两个机器人平台和真实移动操作任务上验证了可迁移性，并开源完整硬件设计与软件栈。
methodHighlights: self-contained wearable backpack as common teleoperation interface
plug-and-play modules for haptics, mobile manipulation and active perception
cross-platform real-world data collection and policy learning validation

papers.title: Crowd4D: Scene-Aware Monocular 4D Crowd Reconstruction
papers.authors: Hongbo Kang, Tianyi Zhou, Qingyang Yang, Hongwei Wen, Jing Huang, Yu-Kun Lai, Kun Li
papers.summary: Crowd4D 做单目视频中的大规模人群 4D 重建，重点解决复杂场景下的人群深度歧义、尺度漂移和地形不一致问题。它不再把人和场景分开重建，而是联合优化 crowd 与 scene，并引入 Human-Scene Interaction Proxy 作为中间几何表示。HSIP 由 Scene Interaction Point Clouds 和 Scene Interaction Surface 构成，用显式场景交互几何来约束人体尺度、位置和时间稳定性。对三维人体、AR 和机器人场景理解来说，这是一篇值得优先看的 4D reconstruction 工作。
methodHighlights: joint crowd and scene optimization from monocular RGB video
Human-Scene Interaction Proxy with SIPC and SIS geometric priors
Crowd Structural Coherence Regularization for occlusion-robust temporal stability

papers.title: D3VL: Understanding Driving Scenes from 3D Time Series Data and Video with Language Models
papers.authors: Heesang Han, A. Lynn Abbott, Abhijit Sarkar
papers.summary: D3VL 把自动驾驶场景理解从 2D 视频问答推进到 3D time-series data + video 的多模态语言模型。论文强调 LiDAR 和 stereo camera 的稀疏、非网格结构让它们很难直接接入 MLLM，但这些 3D 传感器对真实自动驾驶安全又不可替代。D3VL 用一个相对简单的架构融合 2D/3D 时序信息，在 KITTI QA 上相对基线提升 11%。它还提供 Waymo QA 扩展，用来检验模型在多样驾驶条件下处理 3D 与时间信息的能力。
methodHighlights: MLLM framework for joint 2D video and 3D time-series driving data
LiDAR/stereo integration for traffic scene QA and safety reasoning
Waymo QA extension for 3D temporal driving understanding

papers.title: Milo, a Fully Autonomous Indoor/Outdoor Robotic Guide Dog
papers.authors: Florian Golemo, Joanna Wolski, Joel Ruben Antony Moniz, Christopher Pal
papers.summary: Milo 是一个低成本开源机器人导盲犬平台，目标是在不依赖先验 3D 扫描、外部计算或固定环境的情况下完成室内外导航。系统基于改造的 Unitree Go2，结合 voxel mapping、地面/障碍/行人检测，以及在自定义 BEV 仿真器中训练的避障策略。它的贡献不是单个视觉模块，而是把 onboard perception、导航策略和人与机器人协作形态打通。对具身导航和辅助机器人来说，Milo 提供了一个可复现的真实平台基线。
methodHighlights: self-contained low-cost guide-dog robot platform
voxel mapping plus floor, obstacle and pedestrian perception
BEV-simulator-trained obstacle avoidance policy for indoor/outdoor navigation

papers.title: LENS: LLM-guided Environment Simplification for Planning and Control in Clutter
papers.authors: Aileen Liao, Rachel Holladay, Dinesh Jayaraman, Michael Posa
papers.summary: LENS 关注真实多物体 clutter 场景中的机器人规划与控制，把难点定义为场景抽象难以自动生成和动态调整。它用 LLM-guided Environment Simplification 在闭环中合并、裁剪或更新场景实体，例如把堆叠物体合并、忽略远处干扰物，从而得到任务相关的简化表示。方法可以作为 plug-and-play 层接到 classical planning、model-based control 和 VLA 模型上。对操作系统来说，LENS 的价值在于把语言模型用于生成可执行几何/物理抽象，而不是直接输出动作。
methodHighlights: LLM-guided task-specific scene abstraction for clutter
closed-loop merging/pruning of scene entities during task progress
works with planning, model-based control and VLA stacks

papers.title: NavVerse: Benchmarking Indoor-to-Outdoor Embodied Navigation in Continuous Robot Simulation
papers.authors: Junzhe Wu, Yue Hu, Zeyu Han, Po-Hsun Chang, Yinan Dong, Behrad Rabiei, Maani Ghaffari
papers.summary: NavVerse 是一个室内到室外连续机器人导航 benchmark，补上了现有 benchmark 常把 indoor/outdoor 分开、或忽略真实机器人执行的问题。它包含 100 个室内场景、50 个城市室外场景、50 个室内到室外场景，以及 10,000 个 ObjectNav、VLN 和 PlaceNav episodes。评估不只看任务成功，还看路径效率和安全指标，并要求通过可执行机器人接口完成。结果显示当前 RL、VLA 和模块化方法在跨环境导航上仍有明显短板，尤其是从室外进入室内/复杂边界转换时。
methodHighlights: physics-enabled indoor-to-outdoor embodied navigation benchmark
100 indoor, 50 outdoor and 50 indoor-to-outdoor scenes with 10,000 episodes
task success, path efficiency and safety evaluation through executable robot interfaces

papers.title: SafeGen: Goal-Conditioned Video Diffusion of Safety-Critical Scenarios for VLM-Based Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jiangfan Liu, Zexuan Cui, Tianyuan Zhang, Zonglei Jing, Zonghao Ying, Yaoyuan Zhang, Jiakai Wang, Xiaoqi Jiang, Aishan Liu, Xianglong Liu
papers.summary: SafeGen 用 goal-conditioned video diffusion 生成自动驾驶中的安全关键场景，目标是给 VLM-based autonomous driving 做更强的稀有风险评估。它把预设灾难性终态当作强监督信号，引导视频轨迹自然演化到高风险人车交互。方法还使用 VLM 对普通驾驶上下文做 Context Grounded End State Reasoning，挖掘潜在脆弱点，再用 depth-aware geometric projection 和边界条件扩散生成中间帧。它对 world model 和仿真评测的启发是：安全场景生成需要几何落地的终态约束，而不是只靠文本 prompt。
methodHighlights: goal-conditioned diffusion toward catastrophic end states
VLM-based latent vulnerability reasoning for human-vehicle interactions
depth-aware geometric projection plus boundary-conditioned video evolution

papers.title: Contact-Persistent Full Actuation for Aerial Physical Interaction
papers.authors: Abhimanyu Khadga, Abhinav Sinha, Shashi Ranjan Kumar
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 aerial physical interaction 中的全驱动能力重新定义为 contact-persistent full actuation。论文指出 UAV 在持续接触时，部分 wrench 已被交互任务消耗，剩余 wrench 才能用于稳定、抗扰和机动，因此只看自由飞行 rank condition 不够。它建立了包含 actuator limits、task loading 和 residual authority margins 的控制理论框架，并给出可行接触操作的几何证书。对 Physical AI 来说，这篇论文很清楚地说明了“能飞”和“能带力接触”之间的控制可行性差异。
methodHighlights: residual wrench sets under sustained contact task loading
residual authority margin as distance to feasible wrench polytope boundary
margin-aware safety filter and allocation certificate for aerial contact

papers.title: Koopman Dreamer: Spectrally Constrained Latent Dynamics for Stable World-Model Imagination
papers.authors: Jiaqi Li, Xinglong Zhang, Haibin Xie, Yixing Lan, Wei Pan, Xin Xu
papers.summary: Koopman Dreamer 将 Dreamer-style latent world model 的确定性动态核心替换为受谱约束的 Koopman-inspired 结构。它用二维 rotation-scaling blocks 表达阻尼、旋转和近周期模态，并通过 bounded radii 控制长 rollout 中的误差放大。训练上结合 posterior-conditioned EMA teacher、一致性、多步 rollout 和 open-loop observation prediction，缓解训练时 posterior conditioning 与 imagination 时 prior-only 的不匹配。论文在 DeepMind Control 和 UAV-LiDAR navigation 上验证了更稳定的长时想象与闭环控制。
methodHighlights: spectrally constrained Koopman-style latent dynamics
linear and low-rank bilinear action terms for control effects
multi-step rollout-error analysis and posterior/prior consistency training

papers.title: EgoRecovery: Acquiring Failure Recovery Ability Through Human Recovery Demonstration
papers.authors: Zuhao Ge, Yuchen Zhou, Weitao Zhou, Minglei Li, Xinyu Li, Chao Wu, Hanwen Zhao, Haotian Wang, Zuxuan Wu, Xiaosong Jia, Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.summary: EgoRecovery 解决机器人在失败后如何恢复并重试的问题，核心思路是利用人类第一视角 recovery data 替代昂贵的机器人遥操作恢复数据。论文通过设计任务级失败配置和短恢复片段采集协议，让人类每小时生成的有效恢复数据超过机器人遥操作的 10 倍。为跨越 human-to-robot embodiment gap，它把人类恢复示范对齐到 compact corrective-intent space，再用少量机器人恢复示范把 intent 接到可执行动作。部署时 recovery gate 判断何时触发纠正意图，对真实失败恢复任务有直接提升。
methodHighlights: egocentric human recovery demonstrations for scalable recovery data
shared corrective-intent space for human/robot co-training
learned recovery gate activates corrective intent only in failure states

papers.title: Extending a Large View Synthesis Model for Multi-view Panoptic Segmentation
papers.authors: Kwonyoung Ryu, In-Jae Lee, Jonghyun Jin, Hyunjee Lee, Jongmin Lee, Jaesik Park
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 large view synthesis model 从 RGB 新视角合成扩展到多视角 panoptic segmentation。关键观察是：这类模型通过 cross-view attention 学到的空间对应不只适用于外观，也能传播二值编码的 panoptic labels。方法冻结 view synthesis model，把输入视角标签编码后渲染到目标视角，无需显式 3D reconstruction 或 segmentation-specific training。它说明大型视图合成模型内部的几何对应可以成为 3D scene understanding 的通用接口。
methodHighlights: frozen large view synthesis model for label propagation
binary-channel encoding of panoptic labels rendered to novel views
3D scene understanding without explicit reconstruction or task-specific training

papers.title: Look Before You Edit: Attention-Guided Camera Placement and Multi-View Alignment for 3D Gaussian Splatting Editing
papers.authors: Jaeyeon Park, Taeho Kang, Youngki Lee
papers.summary: LB-Edit 面向文本驱动的 3D Gaussian Splatting 场景编辑，解决固定训练视角编辑覆盖不足和多视图编辑不一致两个问题。Attention-Guided Editing Camera Placement 会在多个候选距离上探测扩散模型注意力，选择目标区域注意力最集中的编辑视角集合。Multi-view Attention Alignment 则用 token-level correspondence 共享 self-attention，并把 cross-attention lifting 到 3D Gaussians 上形成共享 3D attention field。该方法用更少编辑视角实现更好的 instruction fidelity、multi-view consistency 和 locality。
methodHighlights: attention-guided camera placement for localized 3DGS editing
self-attention feature sharing via token-level correspondence
cross-attention lifted to Gaussians as shared 3D attention field

papers.title: V2F: Vision-Informed Grasp Force Prediction for Damage-Aware Robotic Handling of Date Fruits
papers.authors: Shahd Shami, Obadah Wali, Eric Feron, Shinkyu Park
papers.summary: V2F 做视觉驱动的抓取力预测，用于脆弱枣果的 damage-aware robotic handling。论文先做机械表征，确定安全抓取 envelope 和果实几何与 bioyield stress 的关系，再用视觉分割、主动轮廓和几何特征提取作为非接触输入。核心模型是结合 Hertz contact equation 的 physics-informed residual neural network，可从视觉描述子和品种元数据预测安全抓取力。对农业机器人和柔性物体操作来说，它展示了视觉先验和物理接触模型如何协同减少破损。
methodHighlights: vision-to-force pipeline with segmentation and geometric descriptors
physics-informed residual network augmenting Hertz contact equation
mechanical characterization defines safe grasping envelope

papers.title: KineBench: Benchmarking Embodied World Models via IDM-Free Kinematic Grounding
papers.authors: Zeyu Liu, Zhangzhe Zhu, Yang Zhang, Chenyou Fan, Chenjia Bai, Xuelong Li
papers.summary: KineBench 评估 embodied world models 的物理一致性，目标是摆脱依赖 inverse dynamics model 从视频抽动作造成的 attribution ambiguity。它用 cascaded visual foundation models 从生成视频逐帧提取 6D end-effector poses，再在 physics simulator 中闭环执行。除了任务成功率，KineBench 还引入 SPARC 和 Maruyama Manipulability Index 评估轨迹平滑性和运动学可行性。对 world model 研究来说，这篇论文把视频生成评测拉回机器人可执行的 3D kinematic grounding。
methodHighlights: IDM-free closed-loop benchmark for embodied world models
6D end-effector pose extraction from generated videos
SPARC and manipulability metrics for robot-centric trajectory quality

papers.title: EA-Nav: Learning Safe Visual Navigation Policies with Embodiment Awareness
papers.authors: Jialu Zhang, Yong Du, Xianda Guo, Shunwang Sun, Xinqi Liu, Yue Sun, Guodong Lu, Wei Sui, Jituo Li
papers.summary: EA-Nav 研究跨 embodiment 的安全视觉导航，指出同一视觉观测对不同机器人可能意味着不同动作。方法用 embodiment geometry tokens 降低仅靠视觉带来的动作歧义，并从互联网视频构造 cross-embodiment navigation 预训练数据。微调阶段采用解耦架构和 multimodal information injection，把空间感知与风险感知纠正分开训练。它对具身导航的启发是：机器人身体几何本身应该进入视觉策略条件，而不是只作为后端控制约束。
methodHighlights: embodiment geometry tokens for cross-embodiment visual navigation
Internet-video pretraining dataset with trajectory augmentation
decoupled spatial perception and risk-aware correction training

papers.title: What Matters in Humanoid General Motion Tracking? An Empirical Study
papers.authors: Fabio Amadio, Enrico Mingo Hoffman
papers.summary: 这篇经验研究系统比较了 humanoid general motion tracking 中常见建模和训练选择的影响。作者构建 YAHMP 开源模块化框架，在 Unitree G1 上控制变量比较 motion-command representation、observation history、action representation、actuation profile、hand-force randomization 和训练策略。结果区分了真正影响 tracking 的选择，以及主要改变能耗、训练复杂度或物理交互能力的选择。它对 Physical AI 研究的意义在于提供了可复现的 humanoid motion tracking 设计消融，而不是只展示单个控制器效果。
methodHighlights: controlled ablations in YAHMP for Unitree G1 motion tracking
evaluation on retargeted human motions and TWIST2 baseline
zero-shot real-robot deployment with perturbation and forceful interaction tests

papers.title: Diffusion ReRoll: Revisable Denoising for Robotic Sequential Prediction
papers.authors: Seonsoo Kim, Seongil Hong, Jun-Gill Kang
papers.summary: Diffusion ReRoll 提出可回滚的 robotic sequential prediction 扩散框架，解决单调去噪难以跨长 horizon 互相修正的问题。它会选择性地把已经局部稳定的区域重新加噪，让这些区域在后续上下文中再次被细化，从而实现 earlier/later segments 之间的交互式修订。论文在 long-horizon planning、policy learning 和 unified video-action modeling 上都验证了提升。对机器人序列生成来说，结构化 re-noising 是比单次 full-sequence diffusion 更适合闭环修正的机制。
methodHighlights: selective re-noising of locally stable sequence regions
iterative cross-horizon revision for planning and policy prediction
validated on OGBench, LIBERO-10 and video-action modeling

papers.title: Unified Prediction and Planning via Conflict-Aware Disjoint Parameter Training
papers.authors: Taewon Seo, Seonae Jeon, Giwon Lee, Kuk-Jin Yoon, Daehee Park
papers.summary: DPT 将拥挤环境中的运动预测和安全规划放进一个统一轻量模型，并指出 shared encoder 中的 Skill Conflict 会让两个任务争抢参数。方法先分别学习任务关键参数区域，再通过 model merging 进行 Disjoint Parameter Training，避免预测邻居行为和 ego-centric safety planning 之间互相干扰。Sparse merging 只合并最有影响的参数，从而提升资源受限设备上的统一模型表现。它对社交机器人导航的启发是：prediction/planning 统一不只是多任务训练，还需要显式处理参数冲突。
methodHighlights: Disjoint Parameter Training for unified prediction and planning
model merging separates task-critical parameter regions
sparse merging reduces interference in compact edge-deployable models

papers.title: STEREOFLOW: Progressive Stereo Matching with StereoDiT and Transition Flow Matching
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Haoran Geng, Xiaotong Yang, Jing Tang, Songlin Wei, Linlong Lang, Yeying Jin, Zheng Zhu, Zhaoxin Fan, Biao Leng
papers.summary: StereoFlow 把 stereo matching 从确定性回归改成带分布建模的 prior-guided generative framework，目标是缓解遮挡、边界和歧义区域中的 regression-to-mean。它由 progressive cascade matching network 生成多分辨率 stereo conditions，再用 frequency-decoupled Pixel Diffusion Transformer 建模 correspondence ambiguity。Transition Flow Matching 让模型能用少步 flow matching 高效优化。对三维重建来说，这篇论文把扩散/flow matching 用在像素级几何对应上，是 stereo 从点估计走向不确定性建模的代表。
methodHighlights: progressive cascade matching network for multi-resolution conditions
StereoDiT models correspondence ambiguity with frequency-decoupled architecture
Transition Flow Matching for efficient few-step optimization

papers.title: Robots Acquire Manipulation Skills in Seconds from a Single Human Video
papers.authors: Guangyan Chen, Meiling Wang, Te Cui, Zichen Zhou, Qi Shao, Shalfun Li, Hang Su, Roy Gan, Hao Wang, Mengyin Fu, Yi Yang, Yufeng Yue
papers.summary: HOST 让机器人从单个 human video 中在推理时快速获得新操作技能，同时尽量保留已有技能。方法把技能获取拆成 self-grounded prediction 级联：先估计机器人在示范任务中的进度，再把未来进度翻译成机器人自身未来观测，最后从预测观测中派生动作。训练目标通过把机器人轨迹和人类示范映射到共享 task progress manifold 来构造，使机器人能主动跟随人类流程并适配自身 embodiment。论文报告平均 29 秒获得新技能，成功率 62%，对少样本机器人学习很有冲击力。
methodHighlights: Human-to-robot One-Shot Skill AcquisiTion from a single video
shared task progress manifold aligns human video and robot trajectory
cascade from progress estimation to future observations to actions

papers.title: ReferTrack: Referring Then Tracking for Embodied Visual Tracking
papers.authors: Hanjing Ye, Tianle Zeng, Jiazhao Zhang, Shaoan Wang, Zibo Zhang, Weisi Situ, Yuchen Zhou, Yonggen Ling, Hong Zhang
papers.summary: ReferTrack 面向 embodied visual tracking，让移动机器人只用前向单目视觉持续跟踪自然语言描述的目标。它把任务拆成 referring then tracking：先从 indexed bounding boxes 中选目标，再基于这个图像落地的选择预测跟踪航点。为了保留目标运动线索，模型维护历史 bounding boxes 的滑动窗口，并用 TVBI tokens 将几何特征注入视觉历史。真实腿式和人形机器人部署显示出较好的 sim-to-real transfer，对语言条件移动感知很实用。
methodHighlights: referring-then-tracking paradigm for embodied visual tracking
TVBI tokens inject temporal viewpoint and bounding-box geometry
co-training on Refer-QA and real robot deployment

papers.title: GaussianSeed: Hierarchical Gaussian Seeding for High-Resolution 3D Occupancy Prediction
papers.authors: Xinzhuo Li, Xianghui Pan, Jiayuan Du, Wei Wei, Liuyi Wang, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen
papers.summary: GaussianSeed 用层级 Gaussian seeding 做高分辨率 3D occupancy prediction，面向自动驾驶和机器人导航中的 dense scene representation。它把 primitives 组织成 coarse-to-fine hierarchy，从而绕开 dense voxel 表示的内存瓶颈，并扩展到 0.1m 空间分辨率。论文还构建了 TJScenes 六相机全景 occupancy 数据集，带有高细节 0.1m 标注。它延续了近期 Gaussian 表示向 3D occupancy/scene understanding 扩展的趋势。
methodHighlights: hierarchical coarse-to-fine Gaussian occupancy primitives
real-time 0.1m-resolution vision-centric occupancy prediction
TJScenes panoramic six-camera occupancy dataset

papers.title: StreamHOI: Interaction-aware Temporal Memory Adaptation for Streaming HOI Video Generation
papers.authors: Zejing Rao, Haoxian Zhang, Xiaoqiang Liu, Yiping Meng, Guoxin Zhang, Pengfei Wan, Fan Tang, Tong-Yee Lee
papers.summary: StreamHOI 是低延迟、长时长的人-物交互视频生成框架，明确把 HOI generation 从离线短视频推向 streaming interactive applications。论文发现标准 sink-local memory 在 HOI 区域和背景区域之间存在历史记忆取舍，不同 transformer block 对历史 memory 的偏好也不同。方法离线做 HOI-aware block profiling，再用 bias-guided memory-specialized training 适配 block-specific memory layout，并用 memory distance scaling 增强早期交互状态访问。它达到 17.6 FPS 和 0.75s 首块延迟，是今日 HOI/生成方向的重点论文。
methodHighlights: HOI-aware block profiling for streaming image-to-video generation
bias-guided memory-specialized training for block-specific memory layouts
memory distance scaling for long-range access to early interaction states

papers.title: PerceptDrive: Perception Prior World-Action Modeling with Adaptive Expert Routing for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Yushan Liu, Tianxiong Lv, Bohua Wang, Hangqi Fan, Chenxu Zhao, He Zheng, Xuchang Zhong, Yifan Xie, Congyang Zhao, Zhihao Liao, Leigang Luo, Yang Cai, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Wenbo Ding
papers.summary: PerceptDrive 把自动驾驶端到端规划表述为 perception prior world-action modeling。它从冻结的 driving-adapted perception provider 和自监督视频编码器中抽取几何、语义和动态先验，再通过 trainable expert-routed world-action model 转成轨迹。训练时用 prior-retention objective 保留各专家分支先验，并用 privileged rule-based sub-metric estimates 蒸馏 router soft gates；推理时只用前向相机，不做测试时搜索或重排。它说明 driving world/action model 的关键是如何保留并按场景路由 perception foundation priors。
methodHighlights: perception-prior world-action model with adaptive expert routing
prior-retention objective anchors expert branches to frozen perception priors
flow-matching actor generates trajectory from predicted future latent

papers.title: SeededGrasp: Language-Guided Grasping in Complex Scenes with Multiple Embodiments
papers.authors: Yang Xu, Gurpreet Singh Mukker, Raymond Wang, Jasper Gerigk, Maria Attarian, Igor Gilitschenski
papers.summary: SeededGrasp 面向复杂场景、多机器人 embodiment 的语言引导抓取，把高层语义选择和低层几何抓取生成解耦。VLM 不直接输出抓取姿态，而是预测一个 seed point，随后由轻量 grasp-generation model 以该点为条件生成可执行抓取。这样既保留语言/任务约束，又避免端到端训练 VLM 和抓取模型所需的大量数据。论文还发布包含 250 万次以上抓取的多 embodiment tabletop grasping dataset，并在仿真和真实实验中分别达到 72% 和 78% 成功率。
methodHighlights: VLM predicts seed point for lightweight grasp generator
decouples semantic reasoning from geometric grasp execution
multi-embodiment tabletop grasp dataset with over 2.5M grasps

papers.title: DINS-IO: Learned Inertial Odometry via Differentiable INS Consistency
papers.authors: Hao Qiao, Yan Wang, Jian Kuang, Xiaoji Niu
papers.summary: DINS-IO 用 differentiable INS consistency 学习惯性里程计，减少对高精度 mocap、VIO 或 SLAM position labels 的依赖。核心约束来自 strapdown INS velocity recursion：预测速度旋到导航坐标系后，应与积分 specific force 在未知初速和常量加速度偏置下保持一致。论文把这个约束写成滑动窗口 least-squares 问题并闭式求解，让 residual 作为自监督 loss 反传到网络。少量标注轨迹再通过 LoRA 校准到 metric velocity，对低成本机器人定位很实用。
methodHighlights: self-supervised inertial odometry from differentiable INS consistency
closed-form sliding-window least-squares residual as training loss
few-labeled-trajectory LoRA calibration to metric velocity

papers.title: Evolving Cache Schedules for Fast Diffusion Policy Inference
papers.authors: Siying Wang, Kangye Ji, Di Wang, Fei Cheng
papers.summary: EVO 是 diffusion policy 推理加速方法，针对重复去噪 action chunks 带来的实时部署成本。它把 cache schedule 表示成 block-timestep lattice 上的完整方案，并用 evolutionary search 全局决定哪些 transformer 计算可以复用。redundancy-aware initialization 和 target-conditioned early stopping 让搜索更可控；得到的 schedule 可直接插入预训练 diffusion policies，无需重训。论文在操作 benchmark 上保持接近全量性能，同时最高实现 8.05 倍 action-generation 加速。
methodHighlights: training-free evolutionary search over cache schedules
block-timestep lattice formulation for diffusion policy transformers
up to 8.05x action-generation speedup on manipulation benchmarks

papers.title: MR-Compare: A Mixed-Reality Framework for Spatially Grounded Visual Comparison of 3D Gaussian Splatting and Mesh Reconstructions with the Physical Environment
papers.authors: Changrui Zhu, Ernst Kruijff, Pengju Zhang, Simon Julier
papers.summary: MR-Compare 是混合现实中的空间对齐评估框架，用 live video see-through 对比 3D Gaussian Splatting 和 mesh reconstructions 与真实环境的一致性。它在 Meta Quest 3 上实现两阶段 registration pipeline 和 3D Slider，用于跨重建表示的现场视觉比较。实验覆盖五种桌面/移动重建流程，并报告厘米级配准误差；其中桌面 3DGS 流程整体表现较强。论文还提出利用 Gaussian anisotropy 的 zero-shot pruning/registration 辅助模块，对 3DGS 在 MR/XR 中落地很有参考价值。
methodHighlights: mixed-reality VST comparison of 3DGS and mesh reconstructions
two-stage registration pipeline plus 3D Slider interface
anisotropy filter improves 3DGS registration robustness

papers.title: Closing the Lab-to-Store Gap: A Data-Efficient Post-Training and Experience-Driven Learning VLA Framework for Retail Humanoids
papers.authors: Roger Sala Sisó, Tiago Silvério, Jakob Sand, Tran Nguyen Le
papers.summary: DEED 面向零售场景中的 humanoid VLA 部署，研究如何把 benchmark 上的策略转成真实 supermarket chip-restocking 系统。它以 Unitree G1-Edu 和 GR00T N1.6 为基础，组合数据高效 post-training、经验驱动 refinement 和 latent-space 分析工具。关键系统技巧包括 control-frequency alignment、数据筛选、任务相关视觉高亮，以及降低对 VLA 直接输出的依赖。论文的结论很务实：lab-to-store gap 更多是系统集成与数据设计问题，而不一定是新架构问题。
methodHighlights: data-efficient post-training for retail humanoid VLA
experience-driven refinement with text advantage prefix and VL value function
latent-space analysis for in/out-of-distribution behavior

papers.title: Towards Miniature Humanoid Tele-Loco-Manipulation Using Virtual Reality and Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Nicolas Kosanovic, Jordan Dowdy, Jean Chagas Vaz
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 VR 上身遥操作和 RL 下身平衡/步态控制迁移到小型 humanoid，用于 tele-loco-manipulation。相比全尺寸人形机器人，小型平台传感器和自由度更少，但更容易被研究社区获得。作者从零构建 compliant full-body telepresence control stack，并在 ROBOTIS OP3 上展示独立于手臂运动的行走，以及立方体搬运遥操作。它是 `cs.RO` 主分类且与 `cs.HC` 交叉，但这里纳入是因为它明确服务人形机器人具身操作，不是普通 HCI。
methodHighlights: VR upper-body teleoperation plus RL lower-body balance/locomotion
full-body telepresence control stack for miniature humanoids
cube relocation experiment with walking and manipulation

papers.title: ATSplat: Compact Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Adaptive Token Expansion
papers.authors: Cho In, Jeonghwan Cho, Mijin Yoo, Gim Hee Lee, Seon Joo Kim
papers.summary: ATSplat 是 compact feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，目标是把 optimization-based 3DGS 的自适应 primitive allocation 带回前馈方法。它先把 patch-level depth 与 camera cues 提升成稀疏 3D anchor tokens，再让每个 token 回归带可学习 3D offsets 的局部 Gaussians，从而摆脱像素网格对 primitive 数量和位置的限制。Adaptive Token Expansion 用 rendering error map 监督 token uncertainty，只在困难区域扩展。论文报告在 RealEstate10K 和 DL3DV 上达到 SOTA 质量，同时 Gaussian 数量减少 5.7 倍以上，单 GPU 低于一秒完成重建。
methodHighlights: Adaptive 3D Tokens as sparse scaffold for feed-forward 3DGS
local Gaussian regression with learnable 3D offsets
uncertainty-guided Adaptive Token Expansion supervised by rendering errors

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-21
reports.summary: 最近一个官方批次筛选出 45 篇相关论文；HOI/4D 重建、3DGS 工程化、几何化 world models 和接触型 VLA 是主线。
trends: 今天的三维生成最亮眼的是“可用于交互/仿真”的场景与动作生成：HarmoHOI 把多视角 HOI 视频和 3D point tracks 共同生成，Text2Villa 强调物理约束的多层室内环境，Scene-SAM3D 则把多视图真实场景资产生成做成 training-free 流程。
3DGS 继续从表示质量转向工程闭环：ExploreGS 解释 blur trap，TopoGS 加入平面拓扑，FF-ProCams 做可重光照 inverse rendering，CaT-GS/SPARE-GS/packet-loss 3D Gaussian compression 分别处理渲染效率、资源预算和网络传输鲁棒性。
world model 与 VLA 今日明显几何化：GeoWorldAD、Depth-Regularized JEPA、World Action Model test-time scaling、PAVXploreRL 都把深度、一致性或物理可行性作为模型评估/训练信号，而不是只看视频生成或动作预测。
机器人操作主线集中在“持久物体状态 + 接触记忆 + 几何终态质量”：Persistent 3D Object Tokens、FM-VLA、Foresight Residual RL、BoxTwin、tight assembly planning 和 grasp compliance 都在补 VLA 对接触、状态验证和下游可行性的短板。

最值得深入阅读的是 HarmoHOI、ReViV、GeoWorldAD、Text2Villa、BoxTwin、Persistent 3D Object Tokens、FM-VLA、RynnBrain 1.1、VIDAR、ExploreGS、VGOcc 和 Fine-Detail Monocular Geometry；它们共同指向一个方向：3D 表示正在成为生成系统、世界模型和机器人闭环控制之间的共同状态语言。

papers.title: HarmoHOI: Harmonizing Appearance and 3D Motion for Multi-view Hand-Object Interaction Synthesis
papers.authors: Lingwei Dang, Juntong Li, Zonghan Li, Hongwen Zhang, Liang An, Wei Min, Yebin Liu, Qingyao Wu
papers.summary: HarmoHOI 面向多视角手-物交互生成，把同步 RGB 视频和全局对齐 3D point tracks 放进同一个扩散框架。论文的关键判断是：HOI 视频要做到多视角一致，必须显式建模跨视角共享的三维几何与运动，而不是只依赖 2D 视频先验。它把 point tracks 表示成 pseudo-video，并用 Global Motion Aligning Diffusion 将粗轨迹细化到 metric-scale 3D trajectory，对 embodied AI 中从人类交互视频合成训练数据很有价值。
methodHighlights: Mixture of Multi-view Diffusion Transformer 联合生成 RGB 与 3D point tracks
point tracks pseudo-video 表示以缩小 2D/3D 先验域差
Global Motion Aligning Diffusion 细化全局 3D 运动一致性

papers.title: ReViV: Reconstructing the Viewer and the View in 4D from Monocular Egocentric Video
papers.authors: Xiaozhong Lyu, Gen Li, Zhiyin Qian, Xucong Zhang, Marc Pollefeys, Siyu Tang
papers.summary: ReViV 从单目 egocentric video 中同时重建观看者和视野，是一个 viewer-and-view 的 4D 重建框架。它把 RGB、相机轨迹、gaze、全身动作、手部动作和深度放在统一的 Masked Generative Egocentric Transformer 中建模，避免把相机跟踪、人身运动和场景深度拆成独立任务。对 AR/机器人学习而言，这类 holistic ego 4D 表示能把人如何看、如何动、如何接触环境统一成可监督状态。
methodHighlights: single-feed-forward egocentric 4D reconstruction
joint distribution over RGB, camera, gaze, body, hand, depth
在 HoloAssist、HOT3D、ARCTIC、Aria Digital Twin、TACO 上验证

papers.title: GeoWorldAD: Geometry World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Songyan Zhang, Jinyuan Tian, Hanbing Li, Daqi Liu, Hao Chen, Wenhui Huang, Fang Li, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Long Chen, Kuiyuan Yang, Chen Lv
papers.summary: GeoWorldAD 把自动驾驶规划放回 ego-aligned 3D space 中，强调 Vision/Video-Action 模型需要显式几何 grounding。模型同时使用当前 geometry 和 latent future geometry tokens，既约束碰撞安全，也预测短时场景演化以避免过度保守。它说明 driving world model 的核心竞争点正在从视频预测质量转向可执行轨迹与未来三维占用/自由空间的一致性。
methodHighlights: ego-aligned 3D geometry grounding for trajectory planning
latent future geometry tokens model short-horizon scene evolution
multi-scale present/future geometry iterative trajectory refinement

papers.title: Text2Villa: Hierarchical Generation of 3D Indoor Environments with Physics-Aware Analysis-by-Synthesis
papers.authors: Xiang Tang, Ruotong Li, Xiaopeng Fan
papers.summary: Text2Villa 做文本到多层室内 3D 环境生成，目标是解决多房间、垂直连通和任意多边形边界等传统 scene generation 难点。宏观层面使用多层建筑数据微调 autoregressive layout generator，微观层面用 Affordance-driven Physical-Semantic Scene Graph 表达支撑、容纳和碰撞约束。它把 MLLM 语义推理、几何碰撞检测和 analysis-by-synthesis 闭环优化结合起来，对仿真和 embodied training environment 生成很直接。
methodHighlights: hierarchical text-to-3D indoor scene generation
A-PSSG encodes physical affordance and semantic constraints
MLLM-guided closed-loop analysis-by-synthesis asset placement

papers.title: BoxTwin: Learning Elastoplastic Articulated Object Dynamics from Videos
papers.authors: Heng Zhang, Gehan Zheng, Kaifeng Zhang, Jay Song, Shivansh Patel, Sonny Hu, Yunzhu Li, Changxi Zheng, Peter Yichen Chen
papers.summary: BoxTwin 面向 elastoplastic articulated objects，从视频中学习可预测、可交互的数字孪生。论文强调这类物体不仅有 articulation，还会出现非线性弹性、塑性屈服和损伤累积，常规刚体或简单可变形模型很难覆盖。它把视频驱动重建、physics-aware constitutive model identification 和长时序后接触行为模拟串起来，对机器人折叠、双臂操作和可变形物体控制很重要。
methodHighlights: video-driven reconstruction of elastoplastic articulated objects
physics-aware constitutive model identification
long-horizon post-contact plastic behavior prediction

papers.title: Depth-Regularized JEPA World Models Learn More Transferable Representations from Real Outdoor Robot Data
papers.authors: Usman M. Khan
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 depth 作为几何先验加入 JEPA world model 训练，目标是在真实户外机器人视频上学到更可迁移的 latent dynamics。它将深度监督、SIGReg latent regularizer 和 training-only overparameterization 结合，用视觉里程计 probe、surprise detection 和 multi-step rollout fidelity 评估表示质量。虽然 API 提交日期早于今日，但它出现在今天官方 cs.CV new 批次中；对 world model 研究的启发是几何先验仍然能显著提高开放环境下的动态预测稳定性。
methodHighlights: depth-regularized JEPA world model from outdoor robot video
SIGReg promotes diverse but geometry-consistent latent dynamics
frozen visual odometry probes and rollout fidelity evaluation

papers.title: Closing the Loop in Humanoid VLA: Persistent 3D Object Tokens for Verifiable Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Peng Ren, Haoyang Ge, Jiang Zhao, Cong Huang, Yukun Shi, Pei Chi, Kai Chen
papers.summary: 这篇 Humanoid VLA 工作把长期 loco-manipulation 中的 object-state divergence 定义为核心问题：机器人在移动、遮挡和接触后仍要验证物体状态。Persistent Object Tokenization 维护 role-indexed 3D object tokens，把任务对象作为持续物理实体跟踪，而不是只依赖当前帧感知。它对 VLA 很关键，因为长程任务的失败常来自状态验证缺失，而非单步动作生成不足。
methodHighlights: persistent role-indexed 3D object tokens
closed-loop verification for humanoid loco-manipulation
object-state divergence formulation across motion/contact/occlusion

papers.title: Scene-SAM3D: Multi-View Scene Asset Generation Without Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Yuqi Zhang, Yadan Luo, Xiangyu Sun, Fengyi Zhang, Zi Huang, Xin Tan
papers.summary: Scene-SAM3D 把单图 3D 生成模型 SAM3D 扩展到 calibrated multi-view scene asset generation，并且不做额外 fine-tuning。它针对真实场景中的遮挡、冗余观测和跨视角不一致，引入训练自由的多视角融合与场景资产生成流程。对具身仿真和机器人操作数据构建来说，这类从多视图直接生成可用 3D scene assets 的方法很实用。
methodHighlights: training-free extension of SAM3D to multi-view scenes
calibrated multi-view observations for scene asset generation
targets embodied simulation/manipulation/navigation assets

papers.title: Splat-based 3D Scene Reconstruction with Extreme Motion-blur
papers.authors: Hyeonjoong Jang, Dongyoung Choi, Donggun Kim, Woohyun Kang, Min H. Kim
papers.summary: 这篇工作处理低光照和长曝光下的 extreme motion blur RGB-D 3D reconstruction。传统 COLMAP/pose estimation 在强运动模糊下会失效，论文用 splat-based 表示和针对模糊的重建策略提升相机位姿与颜色质量。它对机器人夜间/低照度建图很有意义，因为实际部署时 blur 往往比 benchmark 更严重。
methodHighlights: splat-based RGB-D reconstruction under extreme motion blur
handles pose failure and blurry color input
released KAIST-VCLAB implementation

papers.title: VIDAR: Visual-Inertial Dense Alignment and Reconstruction via a Geometric Foundation Model
papers.authors: Diyari Mohammed Salih, Lingxiang Hu, Naima AitOufroukh-Mammar, Fabien Bonardi
papers.summary: VIDAR 将 SVO+IMU 的 metric odometry 与 Depth Anything 3 的 dense geometry 结合，目标是让单目 foundation model 的细节恢复获得稳定尺度。视觉惯性前端提供 camera poses、scale 和 world frame，foundation model 则贡献局部稠密几何，最终融合成全局重建。它代表一种务实路线：不完全端到端替代 SLAM，而是把 foundation depth 当成可度量系统中的几何增强器。
methodHighlights: visual-inertial dense reconstruction with SVO+IMU metric anchor
Depth Anything 3 aligned across time
global reconstruction from metric poses plus dense local geometry

papers.title: Plenoptic Condensation: A Novel Approach to Generalized Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Brevin Tilmon, Alex DeJournett, John Leffingwell, Scott Ackerson
papers.summary: Plenoptic Condensation 提出 Generalized Scene Reconstruction 的多阶段表示，从低表达力的 soupy scene elements 逐步凝聚成更结构化、更高表达力的 scene elements。它强调 Reality Models 需要 spatially varying representational power，才能同时处理边缘、反射和平滑表面。论文展示了手机和无人机采集的 in-the-wild 重建，并突出可测量细微损伤的能力，说明重建表示正在从好看走向可量测。
methodHighlights: multi-stage condensation from low-power to structured scene elements
spatially varying representational power for Reality Models
in-the-wild phone/drone reconstruction and measurement

papers.title: Exploration Matters for Escaping the Blur Trap in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Chengbo Wang, Guozheng Ma, Jinhong Wu, Tie Ji, Yizhen Lao
papers.summary: ExploreGS 研究 3DGS 优化中的 Blur Trap，即显式 Gaussian 表示在非凸优化中容易被梯度偏置带到模糊局部最优。论文将 blur trap 分成 far-side 与 near-side 两类，并用 Random Seeding 与 Random Splitting 两个简单探索算子缓解。它提醒 3DGS 的提升不只来自网络或压缩，也来自对 densification/splitting 优化动力学的重新理解。
methodHighlights: mathematical analysis of 3DGS optimization bias
Random Seeding for far-side blur trap
Random Splitting for near-side blur trap

papers.title: TopoGS: Planar Reconstruction via Topology-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Shanshan Pan, Jiale Chen, Yilin Liu, Hui Huang
papers.summary: TopoGS 将拓扑约束显式加入 3D Gaussian Splatting 的 planar reconstruction。现有 planar 3DGS 往往把平面作为离散集合，容易产生碎片化和边界错位；TopoGS 从多视图 segmentation 中提取全局 2D topological relationships，并把 Gaussian primitives 绑定到结构元素上。对室内重建、CAD/设计和可编辑地图来说，这种 topology-aware 表示比纯视觉质量更有后处理价值。
methodHighlights: topology-aware planar reconstruction in 3DGS
global 2D topological relationships from multi-view segmentations
Gaussian primitives anchored to structural elements

papers.title: FF-ProCams: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Projector-Camera System
papers.authors: Ziyao Wang, Yuqi Li, Wenxing Zheng, Jiaying Chen, Chong Wang
papers.summary: FF-ProCams 面向 projector-camera 系统，用 feed-forward 3D Gaussian inverse rendering 替代耗时的 per-scene optimization。模型从稀疏多视图观测聚合几何与光度线索，并预测可重光照的 Gaussian representation。它把 3DGS 推向主动感知、投影映射和空间 AR 场景，重点是让表示能随 projector illumination 改变而不是固定 baked appearance。
methodHighlights: feed-forward relightable 3D Gaussian inverse rendering
hybrid Mamba2-Transformer encoder for cross-view cues
projector-aware Gaussian representation

papers.title: CaT-GS: Efficient 3DGS Rendering for Large Scale Scenes via Inter-frame Caching and Tile Scheduling
papers.authors: Tingjia Zhang, Bo Chen, Shengzhong Liu, Fan Wu, Guihai Chen
papers.summary: CaT-GS 关注大规模场景下 3DGS 渲染的系统瓶颈。论文指出 tile-based rasterization 存在跨帧预处理冗余、视角遮挡冗余和 tile 负载不均衡，并提出 inter-frame caching 与 tile scheduling。对实时大场景和机器人视角流渲染来说，这类系统优化可能比单纯压缩 Gaussian 数量更直接影响部署。
methodHighlights: speculative multi-frame preprocessing
inter-frame caching for consecutive views
tile scheduling to reduce rasterization load imbalance

papers.title: SPARE-GS: Structural Parsimony and Resource Efficiency for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Zhang Chen, Shuai Wan, Fuzheng Yang, Jiazhi Xia, Weiyao Lin, Junhui Hou
papers.summary: SPARE-GS 将 3DGS 中 primitive proliferation 视为全局预算约束优化问题。方法估计各空间区域的 capacity-normalized demand，并根据预算偏差协调 densification、pruning 和 termination。它的价值在于把 Gaussian 数量分配从启发式局部规则推进到资源效率明确的结构演化策略。
methodHighlights: global budget-constrained formulation for 3DGS structure
capacity-normalized regional demand estimation
coordinated densification/pruning/adaptive termination

papers.title: Packet-Loss Robust 3D Gaussian Compression via Atomic Packaging and GNN-based Error Concealment
papers.authors: Yuxuan Tao, Xuerui Ma, Hao Zhang, Chunhua Peng
papers.summary: 这篇 3D Gaussian compression 工作关注网络传输中的 packet loss，而不是离线压缩率。Atomic packaging 将每个 anchor 的属性打包，避免部分属性丢失造成严重不一致；GNN-based error concealment 则在解码端做 prior-aware attribute inpainting。随着 3DGS 进入云渲染、远程机器人和 XR 串流，这种 transmission robustness 会越来越重要。
methodHighlights: anchor-level atomic packaging for packet-loss robustness
stratified random grouping disperses missing anchors
GNN-based attribute error concealment

papers.title: VGOcc: Learning Visual-Geometric Gaussians for Vision-Centric 3D Driving Occupancy Prediction
papers.authors: Junhong Lin, Xianda Guo, Kangli Wang, Yuqi Ye, Xiaoyu Liang, Yanlun Peng, Wei Gao
papers.summary: VGOcc 做 vision-centric 3D driving occupancy prediction，用 Visual-Geometric Gaussians 表示多相机场景。论文认为只依赖图像域特征会限制 Gaussian occupancy 的体素推理能力，因此把 foundation models 提供的视觉与几何线索加入 primitive 初始化和 refinement。它对自动驾驶三维占用预测的启发是：稀疏 Gaussian 表示需要更强几何监督，而不是只追求表示稀疏。
methodHighlights: visual-geometric Gaussian primitives for 3D occupancy
foundation-model visual and geometric cues
primitive initialization and refinement for surround-view driving

papers.title: RayOcc: Occlusion-Aware Ray Occupancy Estimation via Gaussian Mixture Intensity
papers.authors: Junho Kim, Seongwon Lee
papers.summary: RayOcc 把 camera-only 3D semantic occupancy 中的单 ray 建模改成多标签存在预测。论文认为一条相机 ray 上可能同时有多个被遮挡表面，因此单一 dominant depth hypothesis 不足以表达真实体积场景。它用非归一化 Gaussian mixture intensity 和 Poisson event formulation 得到区间占用概率，对处理遮挡和多层结构很有价值。
methodHighlights: occlusion-aware ray occupancy estimation
Gaussian mixture intensity along each ray
Poisson event formulation for interval-wise occupancy

papers.title: CNS-Edit++: Category-Agnostic 3D Editing with Coupled Neural Shape Representation
papers.authors: Jingyu Hu, Weilong Yan, Zhengzhe Liu, Haipeng Li, Ka-Hei Hui, Hao, Zhang, Chi-Wing Fu
papers.summary: CNS-Edit++ 做 category-agnostic 3D shape editing，将全局 latent semantics 和 3D neural feature volume 组合成 Coupled Neural Shape 表示。它把原先偏 category-specific 的 CNS-Edit 推向更通用的 3D foundation model 场景，并支持局部细节编辑与结构级修改。对 3D 生成后处理来说，这类可控编辑能力是从一次性生成走向可迭代设计的关键。
methodHighlights: Coupled Neural Shape with global latent code plus 3D feature volume
category-agnostic 3D editing with foundation models
co-optimization for local and semantic shape edits

papers.title: Autoregressive B-Rep Shape Generation with Parametric Surfaces
papers.authors: Dafei Qin, Rui Xu, Zeyu Shen, Kaichun Qiao, Hongyang Lin, Qixuan Zhang, Huaijin Pi, Lan Xu, Jingyi Yu, Wenping Wang, Taku Komura
papers.summary: ParaCAD 关注 CAD 中原生 B-Rep shape generation，而不是把形状退化成点云或 voxel。方法用 surface-centric tokenization 显式编码每个 face 的 surface type 和连续参数，再全局求交恢复 edges 与 topology。它对机器人装配、可制造物体生成和 CAD-to-simulation pipeline 很有价值，因为保留参数曲面比渲染友好的 mesh 更接近工程使用。
methodHighlights: autoregressive B-Rep generation from point-cloud conditions
surface-centric tokens preserve native parametric surfaces
global surface intersection recovers valid edges and topology

papers.title: Feature-Guided Diffusion for Non-Differentiable Inverse Rendering
papers.authors: Andrei-Timotei Ardelean, Michael Fischer, Tim Weyrich, Tomáš Iser
papers.summary: FIDE 用 feature-guided diffusion 做 non-differentiable inverse rendering，把 renderer 当成黑盒，只要求它能输出图像。相比把每个候选结果压成 scalar loss，方法从 ViT 提取 dense visual features，再训练 diffusion candidate proposal model。它适合那些真实渲染器、物理仿真或材质模型难以微分的场景，为 physics-aware inverse rendering 提供了更通用的搜索框架。
methodHighlights: black-box inverse rendering without differentiable renderer
ViT dense visual features guide diffusion proposal model
derivative-free candidate evolution

papers.title: Points as Tori: Fast Pointwise Signed Distance for Point Clouds
papers.authors: Nicole Feng, Ioannis Gkioulekas, Keenan Crane
papers.summary: Points as Tori 提出从带法线点云快速计算 signed distance 的解析参数化方法。它用预训练网络为每个点预测 torus curvature 和 shift parameters，从局部 tori fitting 得到可任意分辨率查询的 SDF。方法避免全局优化和空间离散化，对点云重建、碰撞检测和机器人规划中的快速距离查询很有参考价值。
methodHighlights: local torus fitting for pointwise signed distance
feed-forward prediction of curvature and shift parameters
arbitrary-resolution SDF queries without global optimization

papers.title: SaaF: Scene-Specific Ambiguity-Aware 3D Language Fields towards Interactive Real-World Object Retrieval
papers.authors: Yuga Yano, Daiju Kanaoka, Hakaru Tamukoh, Yasutomo Kawanishi
papers.summary: SaaF 是基于 Gaussian Splatting 的 3D language field，用于服务机器人在真实场景中进行交互式物体检索。它解决两个常见问题：CLIP 特征压缩导致相似物体区分度下降，以及自然语言查询本身存在歧义。通过 metric learning 和 scene-specific ambiguity awareness，它把 open-vocabulary 3D map 往可对话、可澄清的机器人检索系统推进。
methodHighlights: Gaussian Splatting-based 3D language field
metric learning for instance-discriminative feature space
ambiguity-aware interactive object retrieval

papers.title: CDIS: Cross-Dimensional Class-Agnostic 3D Instance Segmentation via 2D Mask Tracking and 3D-2D Projection Merging
papers.authors: Juno Kim, Hye-Jung Yoon, Yesol Park, Byoung-Tak Zhang
papers.summary: CDIS 做 zero-shot class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation，目标是让机器人在未知环境中识别未见过的物体实例。方法跟踪跨帧 2D instance masks，再与 3D superpoints 双向关联，形成 2D/3D feedback loop。它避免只把每帧 2D mask 投到 3D 后合并造成的 identity fragmentation，对 manipulation 和 navigation 的开放世界感知有实用价值。
methodHighlights: 2D mask tracking plus 3D superpoint association
cross-dimensional 2D/3D feedback loop
zero-shot class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation

papers.title: MuViSeg: Multi-View Segment Correspondences from Dense Geometry Priors
papers.authors: Denis Fatykhoph, Timur Akhtyamov, Konstantin Pakulev, German Devchich, Gonzalo Ferrer
papers.summary: MuViSeg 把多视图对应从 sparse keypoint/pixel level 提升到 segment level。它基于 MASt3R/VGGT 等 dense geometry priors 为分割区域构造描述子，并用 multi-view self-attention 在多个图像的 segment 集合中联合匹配。对对象级建图、拓扑导航和 scene graph 维护来说，segment correspondence 比像素对应更贴近下游语义结构。
methodHighlights: segment-level multi-view correspondence
frozen MASt3R and VGGT dense geometry priors
joint self-attention over multi-view segments

papers.title: Fine-Detail Monocular Geometry Estimation with Self-Guided Sparse Volumetric Refinement
papers.authors: Lingyu Kong, Ruicheng Li, Ruicheng Wang, Sicheng Xu, Chengtang Yao, Jianfeng Xiang, Jiaolong Yang
papers.summary: 这篇工作针对 monocular geometry estimation 的细节过平滑问题，指出根源在于用 2D 参数化解码 3D geometry 时会混合图像近邻但三维远离的表面特征。Self-Guided Sparse 3D Refinement 将粗 point map 提升到稀疏 3D 空间中 refinement，让特征交互更符合真实三维邻近关系。它对 thin structures、小物体和精细 metric geometry 很关键。
methodHighlights: self-guided sparse 3D refinement for monocular geometry
lifts coarse point maps from 2D image space to 3D space
targets thin structures and fine local geometry

papers.title: DROID-ANCHOR: Odometry-Anchored Recurrent Metric Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Yuxuan Chen, Brook Du
papers.summary: DROID-ANCHOR 用 proprioceptive odometry 为 recurrent metric depth estimation 提供尺度锚点。单目 SLAM/flow 系统虽然鲁棒，但天然有 scale ambiguity；论文用 LSTM Update Operator 编码高频 odometry，并在 backend 中用学习到的不确定性平衡视觉重投影和里程计约束。它对移动机器人来说很实用，因为许多平台都有轮速/IMU 等低成本里程计，可以补单目视觉尺度漂移。
methodHighlights: odometry-anchored recurrent metric depth estimation
LSTM update operator encodes high-frequency odometry
uncertainty-aware metric backend balances visual and odometry cues

papers.title: GLidE-SLAM: GL-Accelerated Indirect-Direct Embedded SLAM
papers.authors: Carlos A. Pinheiro de Sousa, Heiko Hamann, Oliver Deussen
papers.summary: GLidE-SLAM 面向 embedded visual SLAM，把直接跟踪和间接建图分离。系统在中间帧上用 OpenGL ES compute shaders 做 GPU-accelerated direct tracking，将 CPU 留给 map extension 与全局一致性维护。对无人机、可穿戴 XR 和小型机器人而言，这种 vendor-agnostic 嵌入式实现路线比只提高 benchmark 精度更接近部署问题。
methodHighlights: hybrid indirect-direct monocular SLAM
GPU-accelerated direct tracking on intermediate frames
OpenGL ES 3.1 compute shaders for embedded devices

papers.title: Does Robust VIO Need More Learning? Geometry-Verified Visual Measurements under Distribution Shift
papers.authors: Yangyang Ning, Shu Liang, Quanbo Ge, Tianchen Deng, Yuhua Qi, Shenghai Yuan
papers.summary: 这篇 VIO 工作提出一个克制的问题：在 distribution shift 下，鲁棒 VIO 是否真的需要把更多估计环节学习化。方法只让 SEA-RAFT 生成 dense stereo correspondences 和 uncertainty，而 temporal tracking、geometric verification 与 state estimation 仍保持显式几何。它对 Physical AI 很有启发，因为可靠部署常常需要学习前端与几何后端之间的边界清晰，而不是全栈黑盒化。
methodHighlights: minimal-learning stereo VIO under distribution shift
SEA-RAFT visual measurements with uncertainty
explicit temporal tracking, geometric verification and sliding-window estimation

papers.title: Cross-Coordinate Correspondence Pruning for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
papers.authors: Xin Liu, Rong Qin, Huipeng Lin, Leizhi Shu, Jin Wu, Chi-Man Vong, Liang Lin, Jufeng Yang
papers.summary: 这篇 I2P registration 工作关注点云密度对 image-to-point-cloud 粗对应质量的影响。过稀会缺少 inliers，过密又会提高 outlier ratio，因此论文提出 Cross-Coordinate Correspondence Pruning 来缓解密度 trade-off。它对视觉-激光配准、机器人定位和多传感器建图很相关，因为粗匹配阶段常是最终注册精度的瓶颈。
methodHighlights: cross-coordinate correspondence pruning
density-aware coarse-to-fine image-to-point-cloud registration
mitigates sparse-inlier/dense-outlier trade-off

papers.title: PRISM: Multimodal Terrain Mapping for Rover Navigation in Unstructured Environments
papers.authors: Raul Castilla-Arquillo, Carlos Perez-del-Pulgar, Levin Gerdes, Alfonso Garcia-Cerezo, Miguel A. Olivares-Mendez
papers.summary: PRISM 为非结构化环境 rover navigation 构建 RGB-D-T 多模态 terrain mapping 系统。它使用自定义传感器套件采集对齐的 RGB、depth 和 thermal 图像，并用 OmniUnet 做多模态语义地形分割。对户外机器人来说，热成像与深度/视觉融合能提升危险地形区分能力，尤其适合坡地、岩石和低可见度场景。
methodHighlights: RGB-D-T multimodal terrain mapping
OmniUnet vision transformer for terrain segmentation
new annotated BASEPROD and LAENTIEC datasets

papers.title: Distilling Global Traversability Priors for Image-based Affordance Prediction in Off-road Environments
papers.authors: Matthew Sivaprakasam, Samuel Triest, Micah Nye, Deegan Atha, Shehryar Khattak, David Fan, Wenshan Wang, Sebastian Scherer
papers.summary: 这篇工作为 off-road navigation 从第一视角图像中蒸馏 long-range traversability priors。它利用卫星图像计算可行导航路径，监督网络预测超出局部 depth sensing range 的可通行 frontiers。对户外导航来说，这相当于把局部几何地图和全局地形先验连接起来，减少 myopic planning。
methodHighlights: long-range traversability-aware frontier prediction
satellite imagery supervision for FPV affordance learning
image-based off-road navigation beyond local depth horizon

papers.title: Learning Adaptive Safety Margins for Visual Navigation
papers.authors: Junyi Hu, Shuaihang Yuan, Geeta Chandra Raju Bethala, Anthony Tzes, Yi Fang
papers.summary: 这篇视觉导航工作指出 fixed safety margin 在杂乱室内环境中容易过度保守或过度冒险。方法用 context-conditioned safety critic 对 RGB-D diffusion planner 的候选轨迹排序，并通过 privileged ESDF geometry 训练后蒸馏到 perception-only selector。它的价值在于把几何 clearance、CBF residual 和效率目标放到同一排序器中，用于真实 Unitree G1 humanoid 导航。
methodHighlights: adaptive clearance preference critic for visual navigation
CBF residual, detour-ratio and ESDF matching terms
teacher-student distillation from privileged ESDF to perception-only selection

papers.title: From Perception to Assistance: Open-Vocabulary Shared Autonomy for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Murilo Vinicius da Silva, Ricardo V. Godoy, Juliano Negri, Gustavo J. G. Lahr, Ranulfo Bezerra, Marcelo Becker
papers.summary: 这篇 shared-autonomy manipulation 工作用单个 RGB-D 相机理解操作者手臂/手势，并在开放词表目标选择后辅助机械臂对齐目标。它面向工业遥操作中的深度感知不足和碰撞风险问题，将感知、意图识别和局部辅助控制结合。虽然含 cs.HC 分类，但入选原因是 RGB-D、机器人操作和 open-vocabulary 物体辅助强相关，并非普通 HCI。
methodHighlights: single RGB-D camera captures arm motion and hand gestures
open-vocabulary target specification
shared-autonomy assistance for cluttered manipulation

papers.title: FM-VLA: Force-based Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models in Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.authors: Ruicheng Li, Qixiu Li, Ruichun Ma, Yu Deng, Lin Luo, Zhiying Du, Jianfeng Xiang, Huizhi Liang, Ruicheng Wang, Jiaolong Yang, Baining Guo
papers.summary: FM-VLA 为接触丰富操作中的 VLA 加入 force-based memory，解决视觉记忆难以区分小幅接触事件的问题。方法用 VAE 将 force histories 编码为 compact force memory tokens，并把它们作为 action expert 的额外条件。它在隐藏积木、按按钮和按次数擦盘子等 memory-dependent 任务上显示轻量力觉历史能显著提升非马尔可夫操作成功率。
methodHighlights: VAE force memory tokens from force time series
additional conditioning for VLA action expert
targets contact-rich non-Markovian manipulation

papers.title: Foresight Residual RL for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation with Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Yuhan Liu, Xinyu Zhang, Litao Liu, Abdeslam Boularias
papers.summary: Foresight Residual RL 研究 frozen VLA base policy 在长程、紧公差、接触丰富装配中的失败模式。论文指出只给子任务 sparse success reward 会让每个技能孤立变好，但串联后仍然失败，因为当前子任务终态对下游技能可能很脆弱。它用 foresight residual RL 强化终态质量，是把大 VLA prior 与任务级几何/接触可行性结合的方向。
methodHighlights: residual RL over frozen VLA base policy
foresight-aware rewards for downstream subtask robustness
long-horizon contact-rich assembly focus

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models via Zero-Shot Geometric Evaluation
papers.authors: Zesen Zhao, Minkyoung Cho, Hui shen, Boyuan Zheng, Kunxiao Gao, Yulong Cao, Z. Morley Mao
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 test-time scaling 引入 World Action Models，核心是执行动作前用额外算力评估 rollout 是否值得信任。方法用 zero-shot geometric evaluation，按 cross-view depth reprojection consistency 等几何指标选择 sampled rollouts。它说明机器人世界模型的推理预算可以由几何一致性门控，而不是只依赖语言/视觉得分。
methodHighlights: selective test-time scaling for World Action Models
Best-of-N rollout selection
zero-shot cross-view depth reprojection consistency

papers.title: PAVXploreRL: Physical-Action-Visual World Model Reinforcement Learning with Action Exploration
papers.authors: Han Wang, Zijun Wang, Shuoshuo Xue, Rui Cao, Fenjiao Cheng, Xiaodang Liang, Roy Ka-Wei Lee
papers.summary: PAVXploreRL 关注 action-conditioned world models 在 embodied AI 中是否同时满足 physical plausibility、action adherence 和 visual fidelity。它强调只用 in-distribution action-video pairs 会限制模型对 OOD actions 的动态理解，并通过 action exploration 增强学习信号。对机器人策略评估来说，这类 PAV 目标能帮助 world model 更像可用的模拟器，而不是只生成好看的视频。
methodHighlights: Physical-Action-Visual world model objective
action exploration for OOD dynamics
world-model reinforcement learning for policy evaluation

papers.title: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
papers.authors: Kehan Li, Bohan Hou, Minghao Zhu, Tianyi Zhang, Zesen Cheng, Zhikai Wang, Sicong Leng, Xin Li, Xiao Lin, Biying Yao, Minghua Zeng, Jiangpin Liu, Ronghao Dang, Jiayan Guo, Siteng Huang, Haoyu Zhao, Heng Ping, Yaxi Zhao, Kexiang Wang, Tong Lu, Shengke Xue, Jiahao Tang, Yulei Wang, Zejing Wang, Jianwei Gao, Shijian Lu, Chengju Liu, Jianfei Yang, Mingxiu Chen, Deli Zhao
papers.summary: RynnBrain 1.1 是多尺度 embodied foundation model family，覆盖 2B、9B 和 122B-A10B，并强化时空、物理 grounding。相较前版，它增加 contact-point prediction，并让 2B/9B 原生支持 3D grounding，使表示更贴近机器人操作。项目同时发布 RynnBrain-VLA、GitHub 与模型资源，是今天具身基础模型方向最值得跟踪的系统发布之一。
methodHighlights: embodied foundation models at 2B/9B/122B-A10B scales
native 3D grounding and contact-point prediction
RynnBrain-VLA release with project, GitHub and model resources

papers.title: World Translation: Minimizing Sim-to-Real Gap with Backward Dynamics Extraction and Unpaired Domain Translation
papers.authors: Xinchen Yao, Leixin Chang, Hua Chen
papers.summary: World Translation 处理 sim-to-real gap，尤其是接触突变等 partial observability 下历史观测无法恢复隐藏动力学的情况。方法从真实 transition 反向提取 unobservable dynamics information，再做 unpaired simulation/reality domain translation。它在 humanoid、quadruped 和 manipulator 上验证，并做 Go2 真实机器人部署，对仿真训练策略落地很相关。
methodHighlights: backward dynamics extraction from observed transitions
unpaired domain translation preserving dynamics content
sim-to-real experiments across humanoid, quadruped and manipulator

papers.title: Manifold-Guided Motion Planning for Tight Assemblies
papers.authors: Dror Livnat, Michael M. Bilevich, Michal Kleinbort, Dan Halperin
papers.summary: 这篇 motion planning 工作面向 tight rigid-body assembly，强调可行路径常位于接触点定义的 critical manifold 附近。CMG-RRT 用层次 subdivision 将采样偏向 critical manifold 邻域，并证明在标准 clearance 假设下概率完备。对装配、插入和复杂几何约束操作来说，它提供了一个显式利用接触几何结构的规划器。
methodHighlights: Critical-Manifold Guided RRT for tight assemblies
adaptive sampling near contact-defined manifolds
probabilistic completeness and rotational assembly benchmarks

papers.title: Receiver-Centered Robot-to-Human Handover with Grasp-Aware Object Orientation
papers.authors: Federico Biagi, Dario Onfiani, Simone Silenzi, Luigi Biagiotti
papers.summary: 这篇 robot-to-human handover 工作把接收者作为中心，根据工具和人手姿态调整交接方向。系统使用 LLM 做意图识别，并用 MediaPipe 实时 3D hand tracking，让 Franka cobot 以更适合抓取的姿态递交不对称工具。它虽然偏人机协作，但与 grasp-aware object orientation、3D hand tracking 和安全微交互直接相关。
methodHighlights: receiver-centered adaptive robot handover
LLM intent recognition plus real-time 3D hand tracking
grasp-aware orientation for asymmetric tools

papers.title: Retrofitting Existing 3D Objects with Surface-Conforming Capacitive Sensing
papers.authors: Andela Ilic, Junpeng Gao, Zhipeng Li, Yijing Jiang, Rachel Schuchert, Manuel Meier, Philipp Herholz, Christian Holz
papers.summary: 这篇 SIGGRAPH 论文将既有 3D 物体表面改造成可电容感知的多点交互对象，不需要改动物体内部体积。流程先扫描真实物体获得 3D mesh，再在物理和硬件约束下生成/优化 surface-conforming sensor layout，并展开成可裁剪的 2D stencils。虽然分类是 cs.HC，但它本质是 3D 几何、制造和表面传感结合，对 tactile object augmentation 和交互式机器人环境有参考价值。
methodHighlights: scan-to-sensor computational fabrication pipeline
surface-conforming mutual-capacitance layout on 3D meshes
unfolding optimized 3D sensor designs into 2D stencils

papers.title: Predicting Grasping Compliance in Robotic Hands through Analytical-Model-Informed Neural Networks
papers.authors: Qianwen Zhao, Long Wang
papers.summary: 这篇工作把抓取从二元 success/failure 推进到 grasping compliance prediction，关注带力工具使用时手、物体和接触如何在负载下变形。方法用 analytical-model-informed neural networks 建模耦合运动学、被动机械和接触条件下的非线性 compliance。对机器人手和工具操作来说，合规性预测比单纯抓稳更接近真实接触任务需求。
methodHighlights: analytical-model-informed neural networks for grasp compliance
models coupled kinematics, passive mechanics and contact conditions
targets forceful tool-use behavior in robotic hands

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-20
reports.summary: 2026-07-20 官方 arXiv 批次主体 42 篇，聚焦 3DGS/事件重建、驾驶世界模型、HOI 3D scene flow、VLA、触觉接触操作、机器人导航与 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的 3D 表示主线非常明确：E3DGS 关注 3DGS 的 SE(3) 等变表示，ImprovedVBGS 把 continual Gaussian Splatting 推向实时，IPU-3DGS 则从硬件侧验证 3D Gaussian 渲染能否进入边缘/传感器处理器。
几何重建仍在向“在线、低带宽、异步传感器”扩展：Event3R 把事件相机接入前馈全局 3D 重建，SemCom-3DRecon 把通信可靠性纳入移动 3D 重建，HETA++/CSS-BA/EpiDistill 则继续补强 SfM、BA 和单目深度的几何后端。
Physical AI 今天集中在接触：VTAP、BayesContact、VTLoc、Handroid、Contact-Rich Data、Tensegrity GelFoot、OptiTac 和软体操作器 sensing 都在补纯视觉策略缺的接触、力、触觉和手内状态。
VLA/embodied AI 的重点从“能听懂指令”转向部署系统：Xiaomi-Robotics-1 代表规模化真实轨迹，Fast-Slow VLA Driving 解决控制频率，AC-VLA/DAMI/SkillNav/MemoGuard 则分别处理组合泛化、动力学适配、导航记忆和安全回退。
最值得深入阅读的是 E3DGS、Event3R、Orbis 2、Xiaomi-Robotics-1、MotionForesight、VTAP Gripper、BayesContact、VTLoc、Handroid、SCAGE 和 VLMM；它们共同指向一个方向：三维表示正在成为 world models、机器人策略、触觉接触和动态场景记忆之间的共享接口。

Event3R: Asynchronous-to-Global 3D Reconstruction from Event Camera via Spatial-Temporal Feature Aggregation

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-17
reports.summary: 2026-07-17 官方 arXiv 批次主体 36 篇，聚焦 3DGS/前馈重建、world-action models、VLA、具身导航、触觉/力觉操作、机器人仿真与 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的 3DGS/重建主线很强：G2SR、Immediate 3D Gaussian Splat Reconstruction、Instant NuRec、RoGS、JADE-GS、MAGiSt3R 和 Online Neural Space Time Memory 都在把 3DGS/前馈重建/动态 NVS 推向更快、更在线、更可用于机器人或自动驾驶仿真。
World models 与 World-Action Models 从“生成未来视频”进入控制闭环：AeroAct、DriftWorld、RoboTTT、WAM steering、BadWAM 和 RxBrain 分别覆盖飞行、机器人操作、长上下文策略、鲁棒性、攻击面与视觉想象式规划。
VLA/embodied AI 论文强调把 3D、力觉、触觉、长期记忆和在线后训练接入策略：SoftNav 注入 3D scene tokens，LIFT 注入 6D force，KineFuse 和 VQ-Touch 强化触觉，MEMORA/VTM-Nav 使用经验记忆，Reflex 与 LifelongVLA 关注部署时效率和连续学习。
Physical AI 的安全与评测从单点指标转向过程和失败恢复：SafeRelBench、Interventional Causal Circuits、BadWAM、复杂抓取 benchmark 和 VOP-Nav 都把空间关系、因果诊断、对抗失配、执行链路和几何安全纳入评价。
最值得深入阅读的是 G2SR、Open-AoE、AeroAct、DriftWorld、SeeSE3、Instant NuRec、SoftNav、LIFT、RoboTTT、MAGiSt3R、Online Neural Space Time Memory 和 JADE-GS；它们共同指向一个趋势：三维表示正在从离线感知/渲染模块，变成机器人策略、世界模型和仿真系统的中间接口。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-15
reports.summary: 2026-07-15 官方 arXiv 批次主体 32 篇，聚焦 3DGS/VLA、4D 重建、world-action models、embodied VLM、机器人导航/操作和 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天最突出的主线是 3D 表示进入机器人策略：VistaVLA 把 3D Gaussian primitives 变成 VLA 上下文，DiffRadar 用 Gaussian field 做 radar SLAM，PixelLoop/Instance-Enriched Semantic Maps 则把几何拓扑和语义地图接到导航决策。
4D 与动态世界建模继续升温：AGG、SPIN-4DGS、FlowWAM、LIDAR-AD 和 DynTrace 分别从 4DGS 重建、视频原生动作表示、latent driving dynamics 和 MLLM 动态证据跟踪切入。
生成式 3D/4D 系统开始强调可纠错和可控几何：MetaView、Hallo4D、ExtraGS、RealSkin、SeamGen 和 RegHead 都在补“生成质量之外”的几何一致性、对应关系和资产生产接口。
机器人 Physical AI 的论文偏向可部署系统：DenseReward 自动合成失败轨迹，ExToken 改善 VLA-RL 探索，Jetson-PI 与 temporal redundancy 工作关注低延迟控制，MAMMOTH/GaitSpan/Robust In-Hand 则把真实传感器、形态和接触物理纳入策略。

最值得深入阅读的是 VistaVLA、FlowWAM、DiffRadar、Adaptive Gaussian Graph、SPIN-4DGS、Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0、TerraZero、LIDAR-AD、ABot-AgentOS、DenseReward 和 Instance-Enriched Semantic Maps。它们共同说明下一阶段三维视觉表示会更紧密地服务动作、记忆、仿真和物理约束，而不是只服务离线渲染质量。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-14
reports.summary: 2026-07-14 官方 arXiv 批次主体 26 篇，聚焦 3DGS 在线重建/mesh、3D world model、VLA/latent action、手物交互与触觉 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的 3DGS 论文从渲染质量走向系统接口：GeoGS-SLAM、Incremental Gaussian Triangulation、SalientGS、AsySplat 和 Grassmannian Splatting 分别把 Gaussian 表示接入 SLAM、显式 mesh、资源分配、长序列效率和动态表面建模。
世界模型和三维生成更强调“可探索、可执行、可约束”：ABot-3DWorld 把多模态输入变成 3DGS 世界，Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 把基础生成模型约束到 embodiment，Lumo-2/WALA/energy-guided driving world models 则围绕 latent action、预测动态和控制一致性展开。
机器人策略的空间表示正在具体化：robot-centric pointmaps、pixel action maps、object-centric slots、3D scene graphs 都在把视觉语义转成可操作的几何/对象/拓扑结构，而不是直接把图像 embedding 交给控制器。
dexterous manipulation 与 HOI 方向继续把接触关系放到中心位置：REGRIND、GraspGraphNet、EgoSteer 和 TAC-LOCO 分别从人手示范 retargeting、跨手型图结构抓取、第一人称视频预训练和触觉全身控制切入。

最值得优先深读的是 GeoGS-SLAM、ABot-3DWorld 0、Xiaomi-Robotics-U0、OmniX、Incremental Online Scene Reconstruction by 3D Gaussian Triangulation、Towards Predictive, Aligned, and Scalable Robot Learning、See like a Robot、EgoSteer、Action Map Policy、REGRIND 和 GraspGraphNet。它们共同指向一个趋势：三维视觉表示需要同时服务重建、生成、动作和物理约束。

papers.title: GeoGS-SLAM: Online Monocular Reconstruction Using Gaussian Splatting with Geometric Priors
papers.authors: Ruilan Gao, Letian Jin, Yu Zhang

papers.summary: GeoGS-SLAM 把 3D Gaussian Splatting 的可渲染地图与前馈视觉几何模型的 camera/scene priors 结合，用于单目在线稠密重建。它不依赖外部深度传感器，而是先从未标定 RGB 输入估计几何先验，再用 RGB 与先验共同采样 Gaussian primitives。随后系统联合优化相机位姿和 Gaussian 地图，在 SLAM 的在线约束下保留较好的渲染质量。对机器人/AR 的启发是，foundation geometry prior 可以成为 3DGS-SLAM 的初始化与约束来源，而不只是后处理工具。
methodHighlights: feed-forward visual geometry priors for uncalibrated monocular RGB input
Gaussian map expansion from both RGB observations and geometric priors
joint pose-map optimization for online dense 3DGS reconstruction

joint training over image/video generation, embodied scene generation and transfer
multi-view, geometric and embodiment constraints for robot-facing generation

importance-guided MCMC allocation of Gaussian primitives
saliency-aware reconstruction resource placement

papers.title: OmniX: Any-view and Any-time 4D Reconstruction via Feed-forward Trajectory Fields
papers.authors: Yanqin Jiang, Tengfei Wang, Zhengwei Wang, Chenjie Cao, Junta Wu, Wenhan Luo, Weiming Hu, Jin Gao, Chunchao Guo
papers.published: 2026-07-12T17:05:18Z | [Submitted on 12 Jul 2026] | official announcement batch: 2026-07-14 (Tuesday, 14 July 2026 official arXiv new listing)
papers.summary: OmniX 面向大相机运动视频下的任意视角、任意时间 4D 重建。它不再逐帧预测静态点云，而是为每个像素预测稠密 3D point trajectories，并用动态 tokens 表示紧凑的 3D motion。方法将动态运动建模与静态几何预测解耦，适合处理大视角变化下的动态场景聚合。对 4D reconstruction 来说，它把 feed-forward 预测推进到可跨时间和视角的轨迹场表示。
methodHighlights: dense 3D point trajectory prediction for each video pixel
decoupled dynamic motion modeling and static geometry prediction
compact dynamic tokens exploiting sparse low-rank 3D motion

papers.title: Incremental Online Scene Reconstruction by 3D Gaussian Triangulation
papers.authors: Yanjin Zhu, Shaofan Liu, Jianke Zhu
papers.published: 2026-07-12T10:22:18Z | [Submitted on 12 Jul 2026] | official announcement batch: 2026-07-14 (Tuesday, 14 July 2026 official arXiv new listing)
papers.summary: 这篇论文提出直接从 dense geometric Gaussians 增量三角化显式 mesh 的在线场景重建框架。它避免先离线把 3DGS 转成隐式场再抽 mesh 的中间步骤，使渲染表示和下游几何表面可以同步更新。关键算法是 direct meshing 与 plane-based pulling constraint，用于让 Gaussian primitives 动态贴合局部表面。对机器人地图和 XR 系统来说，它把 3DGS 的可视化优势与显式 mesh 的可操作性接在一起。
methodHighlights: direct meshing from dense geometric Gaussian representation
incremental mesh extraction and update during online reconstruction
plane-based pulling constraint for local surface alignment

papers.title: MAC-Splat: Multi-Attribute Consistency for High-Fidelity Sparse-View Reconstruction

geometry/depth/appearance agreement under limited views
