papers.title: AsySplat: Efficient Asymmetric 3D Gaussian Splatting for Long-Sequence Scene Modeling
papers.authors: Yingji Zhong, Dave Zhenyu Chen, Fuzhao Ou, Youyu Chen, Zhihao Li, Lanqing Hong, Dan Xu
papers.published: 2026-07-13T01:39:19Z | [Submitted on 13 Jul 2026] | official announcement batch: 2026-07-14 (Tuesday, 14 July 2026 official arXiv new listing)
papers.summary: AsySplat 关注长序列场景建模中 generalizable 3DGS 的冗余计算。作者观察到高质量 NVS 并不总是需要同等精度的几何，且外观学习通常比几何恢复更容易，因此将几何分支和外观分支做非对称设计。几何分支处理粗粒度 tokens，外观分支用细粒度 tokens 捕获细节，两者通过双向连接交互。它对大规模长视频 3DGS 的启发是，几何和外观应按任务难度分配不同算力。

coarse geometry tokens plus fine appearance tokens
bilateral connections for long-sequence generalizable 3DGS

papers.title: Grassmannian Splatting I: Moving rank-2 Spacetime Surfels for Dynamic Scene Rendering

Grassmannian parameterization of normals and velocity
surface-oriented alternative to full-rank 4D Gaussian slicing

papers.title: 3D Scene Graph Prediction: Generating Hierarchical Models from Partially Observed Environments

papers.authors: Peijun Tang, Shangjin Xie, Baifu Huang, Binyan Sun, Haotian Yang, Kuncheng Luo, Weiqi Jin, Shilin Fang, Jianan Wang

papers.title: WALA Learning Executable Latent Actions from Action-Labeled Demonstrations and Action-Free Videos
papers.authors: Jiahao Liu, Zhongpu Xia, Shuai Tian, Huangrui Li, Yuhang Zheng, Ning Ma, Xin Fu, Xiaotian Liu, Jing Li, Yixian Li, ShangQing Zhou, Zebin Xing, Linbo Wang, Chaoyue Li, Haoran Li, Dongbin Zhao

action abstraction for embodied policy learning

papers.title: See like a Robot: Robot-Centric Pointmaps for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Byungkun Lee, Dongyoon Hwang, Dongjin Kim, Hojoon Lee, Minho Park, Jaegul Choo

methodHighlights: robot-centric pointmap representation for VLA models
geometry-aware visual input aligned with action execution

papers.authors: Yifan Zhong, Zhang Chen, Tianrui Guan, Fanlian Zeng, Yuyao Ye, Tianjia He, Ka Nam Lui, Jiayi Li, Tingrui Zhang, Ruilin Yan, Xinhao Ji, Guangyu Zhao, Wenjie Lou, Jiayuan Zhang, Yuanpei Chen, Yaodong Yang

papers.authors: Haojie Huang, Zhang Ye, Linfeng Zhao, Boce Hu, Mingxi Jia, Yu Qi, Ahmed Agha, Dian Wang, Robert Platt, Robin Walters

papers.authors: Yunhai Feng, Natalie Leung, Jiaxuan Wang, Lujie Yang, Haozhi Qi, Preston Culbertson

papers.title: GraspGraphNet: Graph-Structured Multi-Embodiment Dexterous Grasp Generation
papers.authors: Yeonseo Lee, Taeyeop Lee, Hyosup Shin, Guebin Hwang, Sungho Jo

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-13
reports.summary: 2026-07-13 官方 arXiv 批次主体 23 篇，聚焦生成先验到机器人执行、3DGS/SfM 系统化、触觉接触操作与全景/world model；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的主体论文非常集中在“生成先验如何进入可执行物理系统”：GenVid2Robot、PhysV2A、DemoBridge 和 AgenticFocus 都在解决从视频/人类示范到机器人轨迹之间的几何、抓取、碰撞和可达性断层。
3DGS 和几何 foundation model 正在向系统接口化发展：StereoSplat+ 追求单 stereo pair 因果重建，SplatCtrl 把 Gaussians 变成控制安全约束，AnythingReality 把在线 3DGS 接进 VR/VLM 交互，Glob3R 与 Co-VGGT 则把 foundation prediction 转成 SfM/共视可用信号。
触觉与接触成为 Physical AI 的关键变量：TactiDex 和 TACTIC 都不满足于运动学模仿，而是把 tactile/contact supervision、contact Jacobian 和 MPC 纳入操作闭环。
world model 的几何归纳偏置更明确：PanoWorld 使用全景旋转等变性和 ray-conditioning，CD-LAM 从因果角度清理 latent action，MultiView-Bench 则指出 VLM 的多视角 3D 融合仍是短板。

最值得优先深读的是 Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners、SplatCtrl、GenVid2Robot、Glob3R、StereoSplat+、Hydra++、TactiDex、TACTIC、Causally Debiased Latent Action Model、PanoWorld 和 What VGGT Knows About Overlap。它们共同说明三维视觉下一阶段的关键不是单点指标，而是能否把生成先验、几何估计、接触状态和控制可行性放进同一个闭环。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-10
reports.summary: 2026-07-10 官方 arXiv 批次主体 22 篇，聚焦 physics-ready mesh/3DGS、HOI 接触控制、world-action models、VLA/机器人规划与仿真基础设施；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的主体不缺论文，关键变化是“生成/重建结果能不能进入物理闭环”：HoloTetSphere、ContactMimic、EVIS、DexVerse、Track2Map 都把几何、接触、传感器或 benchmark 明确接到可执行系统中。
3DGS 继续向大场景、动态场景和非刚性场景扩展：PanoLOG 解决全景大场景分块，MoE-GS/MoDE 研究动态形变专家，Track2Map 则把 deformable 3DGS 推入在线手术 SLAM。
HOI/手物交互和 articulated objects 的热度很高：GIRAF、ContactMimic、DexVerse、AnyDexRT 分别从全身交互生成、接触控制、基准覆盖和遥操作 retargeting 补上 Physical AI 的关键接口。

world model 与 VLA 的焦点从“更大模型”转向“合适表征”：EgoWAM 比较 Pixel/DINO/3D flow world targets，Native Video-Action Pretraining 从视频动作 tokenizer 和因果预训练重做 embodied foundation model，APIVOT 与 WCog-VLA 则把视觉想象、3D 状态和未来轨迹合进规划。
生成内容的几何意识继续增强：DreamCharacter-1、SkelGen4D、Canvas360、GRE-Diff 共同指向一个方向，即 3D/4D 资产、全景图和室内布局生成需要可控结构，而不只是好看的像素。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-09
reports.summary: 2026-07-09 官方 arXiv 批次主体 28 篇，聚焦 sim-ready 3D/world engines、3DGS/SLAM、VLA 记忆与触觉、world model 可信评测和 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的核心信号是 sim-ready 世界正在取代“只可观看”的三维生成：CARLA-GS、EmbodiedGen V2、RoboSnap、SPEAR 和 WildCity 都把重建/生成结果接到物理执行、闭环评测或策略训练里。
3DGS 的使用继续从新视角合成外扩到机器人地图和仿真基础设施：GeoGS-SLAM 做 geometry-only Gaussian SLAM，NoDrift3R 处理长序列 pose drift，RoboSnap 和 CARLA-GS 则把 Gaussian 场景变成可交互 sim layer。
VLA/机器人操作的重点明显转向“状态、记忆、触觉与注意力”的结构化接入：GeoProp 显式对齐本体状态和视觉 token，LaMem-VLA/NativeMEM 处理长程记忆，Pelican-VLA 诱导接触区域注意，TouchWorld 把触觉 world model 接进灵巧操作闭环。
world model 的评测与可信度开始变得更严肃：Admissibility for World-Model Simulators 指出视觉质量不能替代动作响应验证，Instruction Leakage 论文提醒语言目标可能污染 spatial grounding，Geometric Collapse 则说明 dense geometry model 仍缺少物理因果自检。
场景级理解正在向长期、跨视场、多主体和人类协作扩展：PUF 关注 uncertainty-aware 3D scene graph 融合，SpaR3D-MoE 做稀疏视图 3D 推理，G-PROBE/CILC 处理多机器人定位与安全，CoMind 为 human-object interaction 和协作辅助提供带 3D scans 的数据资源。

papers.authors: Xinjie Wang, Liu Liu, Taojun Ding, Andrew Choi, Chaodong Huang, Mengao Zhao, Ziang Li, Jackson Jiang, Chunlei Yu, Shengxiang Liu, Wei Xu, Zhizhong Su

agentic generation/editing pipeline across assets, scenes and affordances
generated environments used for policy training and real-robot transfer

papers.title: GeoGS-SLAM: Geometry-Only Gaussian Splatting for Dense Monocular SLAM

papers.summary: GeoGS-SLAM 直接质疑 3DGS-SLAM 是否必须同时优化外观和几何，答案是对机器人任务而言几何可能更关键。它提出 Geometry-only Gaussian Splatting，只保留空间参数，从而减少超过 80% 的 per-primitive 参数，并强化光照变化下的鲁棒性。系统还用局部平面初始化和 loop closure 后的全局 Gaussian map 更新避免地图撕裂。对 dense monocular SLAM 来说，这篇提供了一个很清晰的方向：3DGS 可以被压成几何优先的在线地图表示。
methodHighlights: geometry-only Gaussian primitives with far fewer parameters
single-view/multi-view geometric supervision and local-plane initialization
loop-closure map update that globally transforms the Gaussian map

methodHighlights: Raymap-Guided Coupling between geometry, appearance and pose
unified RGB reconstruction, raymap consistency and camera regularization objective
dual-frequency viewpoint scheduling for long sequence stability

papers.title: GeoProp: Grounding Robot State in Vision for Generalist Manipulation
papers.authors: Guoyang Zhao, Quanhao Qian, Gongjie Zhang, Wenhao Li, Jiuniu Wang, Xiaowei Lu, Deli Zhao, Ran Xu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: GeoProp 针对 VLA/机器人策略中 proprioception 与视觉 token 脱节的问题，提出轻量可插拔适配器。它把机器人状态投影到图像平面采样局部视觉特征，构造 grounded state token，并用 FiLM 把状态空间先验注入对应视觉特征。为捕捉动作意图，GeoProp 还从短时运动预测坐标采样 look-ahead visual context。它的贡献不在于更大模型，而是让 3D kinematics 与 2D perception 建立显式几何对应。
methodHighlights: project robot proprioception into image-space visual features
grounded state token plus FiLM spatial priors
look-ahead feature sampling from recent kinematics

papers.title: Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Hongyu Qu, Jianzhe Gao, Xiaobin Hu, Shaohuan Yang, Xinlei Yu, Rui Yan, Wenguan Wang, Xiangbo Shu, Shuicheng Yan
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇提出 LaMem-VLA，把历史经验重构为短期和长期 latent memory tokens，并直接插入 VLA 连续嵌入空间。它用 curator、seeker、condenser、weaver 四个组件组织历史、检索相关证据、压缩成 latent token，再与当前 observation/instruction 共同参与推理。相比把记忆放在策略外部或简单扩大观察窗口，这种设计让历史经验在同一个 latent reasoning space 中参与动作形成。对长程操作任务，它提供了一个内生记忆范式。
methodHighlights: short-term and long-term latent memory vaults for VLA models
retrieval and condensation of historical evidence into compact memory tokens
memory tokens woven into the same embedding sequence as current observation and instruction

papers.title: NativeMEM: Native Memory Compression for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Ziye Wang, Modi Shi, Chaojun Ni, Jiazhi Yang, Mengdi Li, Zhizhong Su, Tianwei Lin, Hongyang Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: NativeMEM 同样关注 VLA 长程历史，但更强调高频更新和低延迟。它复用 VLA 自身 vision encoder，把每个历史帧和相机视角压缩成单个 token，直接追加到输入序列中。训练上先用 frozen VLA 监督通用 memory tokenizer，再进行任务微调。结果表明这种原生记忆压缩可以在不引入外部 planner 或新记忆模块的前提下显著提升长程 manipulation 成功率。
methodHighlights: repurpose the VLA vision encoder as native memory tokenizer
compress each historical frame/view into one memory token
low-latency long-horizon memory without external planner

papers.title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
papers.authors: Zeyuan Ding, Wenhai Liu, Yang Xu, Jiayu Hu, Yinda Chen, Yi Zhang, Yong Dai, Jian Tang, Xiaozhu Ju
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.LG
papers.summary: Pelican-VLA 0.5 把视觉语言理解、未来帧生成和动作预测放进统一架构，关注 attention-level generalization。论文观察到其 action pathway 在没有对象标注、分割 mask、attention supervision 或任务微调时，已经能聚焦到指令相关物体和接触区域。作者把这一行为归因于 perception 与 action 之间的 learnable Reasoning Slots，它们形成紧凑瓶颈并诱导 manipulation-centric attention。对 VLA 研究而言，这篇强调“先关注哪里，再决定怎么动”可能是泛化关键。
methodHighlights: unified architecture for VLU, future-frame generation and action prediction
learnable Reasoning Slots between perception and action
emergent manipulation-centric attention without explicit attention supervision

papers.title: TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Jianyi Zhou, Feiyang Hong, Yunhao Li, Yicheng Zhao, Yongjue Cen, Zirui Liu, Jiakang Huang, Zirui Chen, Ruiyang Zhang, Weizhuo Zhu, Xuhua Song, Shuo Yang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: TouchWorld 把触觉作为既能预测接触演化、又能快速闭环修正的基础模型信号。它采用层级策略：高层做 vision-language subtask planning 并预测 tactile subgoals，中层生成 visuo-tactile goal-conditioned action chunks，低层用最近触觉和本体反馈做高频残差修正。相比把 touch 当作低频观测流，TouchWorld 明确分离语义规划、接触世界模型和局部反应控制。对灵巧操作和 Physical AI 来说，这篇说明“隐藏接触状态”不能只靠视觉语言补足。
methodHighlights: hierarchical split of VLA planning, tactile world-model prediction and tactile residual control
tactile subgoals as predictive contact references
high-frequency tactile refinement for slip, force and contact stability

papers.title: Compositional Motion Generation from Demonstration with Object-Centric Neural Fields
papers.authors: Ahmet Ercan Tekden, Yasemin Bekiroglu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇把 learning from demonstration、object-centric neural fields 和 motion primitives 结合起来做可组合机器人运动生成。方法用 canonical neural fields 与 latent-conditioned deformations 表达物体级几何变化，再由 temporal MoE 将 object-conditioned movement primitives 组合成完整轨迹。它的优点是把视觉结构和动作生成放在共享对象表示上，从而支持跨场景配置的系统泛化。对长期 manipulation，它提供了一种比纯图像策略更可解释、更数据高效的空间-时间组合建模路径。
methodHighlights: object-centric neural fields with latent-conditioned deformations
temporal MoE over object-conditioned movement primitives
compositional learning from demonstration in 3D scene representations

papers.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Shuailei Ma, Jiaqi Liao, Xinyang Wang, Jingjing Wang, Chaoran Feng, Zijing Hu, Chong Bao, Zichen Xi, Yuqi Gan, Weisen Wang, Yanhong Zeng, Qin Zhao, Zifan Shi, Wei Wu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Shangzhan Zhang, Jiahao Shao, Yipengjing Sun, Liangxiao Hu, Lunke Pan, Nan Xue, Kecheng Zheng, Yinghao Xu, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Ka Leong Cheng
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇提出 LingBot-Video，一个面向 embodied intelligence 的 MoE 视频预训练范式。作者认为通用视频生成模型偏向视觉保真和创意，而机器人需要效率、物理合理性和动作理解，因此从架构、数据和奖励三个层面调整。数据侧加入 robot-oriented footage、manipulation、navigation 和 egocentric 视角；训练侧用多维奖励约束 physical rationality 与 task completion。它与 VLA/world model 趋势相呼应：视频基础模型正在被重新调校为物理行动模型的底座。
methodHighlights: DiT-based MoE video pretraining tailored for embodied intelligence
data profiling with robot-oriented, navigation and egocentric footage
multi-dimensional rewards for physical rationality and task completion

papers.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
papers.authors: Zelin Gao, Qiuyu Wang, Jiapeng Zhu, Jingye Chen, Zichen Liu, Qingyan Bai, Jiahao Wang, Yufeng Yuan, Hanlin Wang, Yichong Lu, Ka Leong Cheng, Haojie Zhang, Jian Gao, Tianrui Feng, Yuzheng Liu, Yao Yao, Yinghao Xu, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Hao Ouyang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Infinite Worlds / LingBot-World 2.0 面向长时、实时、多交互元素的生成式 world simulator。它通过 causal pretraining 维持无界交互时长，并蒸馏实时版本以支持 720p 60fps 视频流。系统扩展了攻击、射箭、施法、射击等动作，并加入 pilot/director agent 负责角色行为与环境元素生成。它更偏交互世界生成，但对具身智能有启发：world model 正在从短视频预测走向实时可玩环境。
methodHighlights: causal pretraining for unbounded interaction horizon
distilled real-time model for 720p 60fps streaming
agentic harness with pilot and director agents for behavior and environment synthesis

papers.title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
papers.authors: Christian Oefinger, Finn Rasmus Schaefer, Korbinian Moller, Mattia Piccinini, Johannes Betz
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.SE
papers.summary: 这篇不是提出新渲染模型，而是提出 world-model simulator 作为测试 oracle 前必须先被认证的问题。作者认为 FVD 等视觉指标不能保证模型对动作响应正确，尤其不能支撑安全结论。论文借鉴 VV&A、SOTIF 和场景测试标准，定义 L0-L4 admissibility ladder，并在自动驾驶 world models 上展示视觉质量与动作鲁棒性可能排序相反。它对机器人和自动驾驶很重要，因为 learned simulator 的 verdict 不能天然等价于真实安全证据。
methodHighlights: admissibility ladder for world-model simulators used as test oracles
separation of visual fidelity from action-following and closed-loop verdict validity
safety-critical simulation framing using VV&A and SOTIF practices

papers.title: Grounding Spatial Relations in a Compact World Model: Instruction Leakage and a Goal-Free Dynamics Fix
papers.authors: Yufeng Wang, Lu Wei, Haibin Ling
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.AI
papers.summary: 这篇研究紧凑 world model 中空间关系 grounding 是否真的来自感知，而不是直接抄写指令。作者发现 goal-conditioned predictor 可以在 relation readout 上很高，但去掉目标后接近随机，加入反事实指令时预测 anchors 会跟随错误指令。论文把这种问题称为 instruction leakage，并建议把 goal 从 dynamics 中移出，让它只进入 planner cost，同时监督 read path。对语言条件 world model 和机器人桌面任务评测而言，这篇是一个重要的诊断提醒。
methodHighlights: counterfactual protocol for detecting instruction leakage in goal-conditioned world models
goal-free dynamics fix that keeps goal in planner cost rather than dynamics
supervised read path for instruction-independent spatial grounding

papers.title: Ego-Human Motion Prediction with 3D-Aware LLM
papers.authors: Yujin Bae, Jaewoo Jeong, Hyeonseong Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Ego3DLM 面向第一人称视角下的人体运动预测，强调 AR/VR、协作机器人和 embodied AI 都需要 3D 场景语义约束。它用三点 tracking、3D scene features 和 egocentric video，同步解码过去/未来姿态以及过去/未来 narration。训练分为 3D 空间语义预训练、四输出 holistic instruction tuning 和基于 GRPO 的奖励微调。对人机协作场景，这篇展示了运动预测不应与语义描述分开建模。
methodHighlights: 3D scene-grounded LLM for egocentric human motion prediction
single autoregressive pass for past/future pose and narration
GRPO finetuning with intra-modal and inter-modal rewards

papers.title: CoMind: Understanding Collaborative Human Activity from Multiple Minds and Views
papers.authors: Alexey Gavryushin, Dingxi Zhang, Zhao Huang, Alexandros Delitzas, Jiaqi Chen, Ben Ellis, Cedric Zoellner, Manthan Patel, Manuel Kaufmann, Marc Pollefeys, Xi Wang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: CoMind 是一个多视角协作人类活动数据集，聚焦 cooking 场景中的 joint attention、social cues、agent-object interactions 和 handover prediction。它同时包含 egocentric/exocentric video、高质量音频、gaze tracking、3D scene/object scans 以及丰富时间对齐标注。虽然不是传统 HOI 视频生成论文，但它提供了带 3D 扫描和物体交互标注的人类协作数据。对机器人主动辅助和 human-object interaction 感知任务，它值得作为数据资源关注。
methodHighlights: dual-view egocentric/exocentric collaborative activity dataset
3D scene and object scans plus gaze, audio and social/object annotations
benchmarks for joint attention, object interaction anticipation and collaborative handover

papers.title: PLED-VINS: A Point-Line Event-Based Visual Inertial SLAM for Dynamic Environments
papers.authors: Seunghun Lee, Jihun Nam, Dong-Uk Seo, Hyun Myung
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: PLED-VINS 用事件相机和 IMU 做动态环境中的 monocular visual-inertial SLAM。它用 entropy-recency score map 衡量点/线特征的时间可靠性，并在统一 point-line robust bundle adjustment 中估计几何可靠性。随后通过自适应权重融合时间与几何可靠性，抑制移动物体和快速运动带来的不可靠观测。对 event-based SLAM 来说，这篇的价值在于把动态场景可靠性显式纳入状态估计。
methodHighlights: entropy-recency temporal reliability map for point and line events
unified point-line robust bundle adjustment
adaptive temporal/geometric reliability weighting in dynamic scenes

papers.title: G-PROBE: Cross-FOV Place Recognition and Certainty-Coupled Localization for 3D Point Clouds
papers.authors: Jinseop Lee
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: G-PROBE 研究不同视场 LiDAR/点云传感器之间的 place recognition 和全局定位。它用 virtual sensor decomposition 枚举 cross-FOV 分支，编码 heading hypotheses，并用 score-scale-invariant gamma-SGRT 抑制部分视场下的 heading aliasing。后端 CG-GICP 只在高确定性共同观测点上细化 6-DoF 位姿，把描述子评分和度量配准耦合起来。对多传感器机器人定位和跨平台地图复用，它是一个实用的 learning-free 方案。
methodHighlights: virtual sensor decomposition for cross-FOV point-cloud place recognition
score-scale-invariant gamma-SGRT for heading ambiguity suppression
certainty-coupled GICP over high-confidence co-observed points

papers.title: CILC: Cryptographically-secure Inter-agent Loop Closure Candidate Detection for Multi-Agent Collaborative SLAM
papers.authors: Andrew Fishberg, Yixuan Jia, Jonathan P. How
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: CILC 关注 collaborative SLAM 中 inter-agent loop closure descriptor 交换带来的隐私泄漏。作者先展示恶意 swarm 成员可以从公开 global descriptor 广播中近似重建诚实机器人图像和轨迹，再用 Secure Multi-Party Computation 只保护 loop closure candidate detection 的相似度比较步骤。这样既避免全流程加密的过高成本，也把最敏感的信息交换变成私密计算。对多机器人 3D 建图系统来说，它把安全与几何定位问题放在同一个工程约束下。
methodHighlights: privacy attack analysis on public global descriptors in collaborative SLAM
SMPC-based inter-agent loop closure candidate detection
real-time validation across visual and LiDAR descriptors

papers.title: Disturbance-aware Motion Planning for Over-actuated Underwater Vehicles Exploiting Actuation Redundancy for High-fidelity 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Yuer Gao, Tongqing Xu, Qingyang Liu, Yi Cai
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇把水下机器人推进器扰动与视觉重建质量直接耦合起来，而不是只优化跟踪和稳定性。对于八推进器 ROV，同一运动可以由多种推力分配实现，作者在冗余空间中搜索能最小化目标区域扰动的分配。其 thruster-wake proxy 与实时 allocator 在实验中降低颗粒速度并显著改善 3D reconstruction RMSE。它是 Physical AI 里很好的例子：控制策略要考虑自己对感知输入质量的物理影响。
methodHighlights: actuation-to-perception coupling for underwater 3D reconstruction
thruster-wake proxy with redundancy-resolving allocation
real-time disturbance minimization improving reconstruction RMSE

papers.title: Geometric Collapse: When Vision Models Fail to Verify Physical Causality
papers.authors: Wentao Zhang, Jinhu Qi, Weiqiang Jin, Yifei Zhang, Chan-Tong Lam, Irwin King
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Geometric Collapse 用 Scrambled Edges 这个受控反事实来测试 dense geometric predictors 是否能拒绝物理上不成立的边缘证据。实验显示 CNN/ViT/SSL 深度预测器会受到远超能量匹配噪声的扰动，错误还会传播到 mask 外区域。即便给 oracle corrupted region，输出级修复也只能恢复部分错误。它对三维视觉基础模型的提醒是：几何预测器需要显式 plausibility scoring 和 cue quarantine，而不是只扩大预训练规模。
methodHighlights: Scrambled Edges counterfactual for physically unsupported geometry cues
controlled tests on dense depth predictors across NYU Depth v2 and KITTI
evidence of global error propagation and limited output-level repair

papers.title: CaLiSym: Learning Symplectic Dynamics of Real-World Systems through Structured Canonical Lifts
papers.authors: Aristotelis Papatheodorou, Pranav Vaidhyanathan, Natalia Ares, Ioannis Havoutis, Gerard J. Milburn
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.LG
papers.summary: CaLiSym 把精确 symplectic learning 扩展到带驱动、耗散和约束的真实机器人系统。它不在测量状态上直接强加 symplecticity，而是把状态和物理端口嵌入结构化 lifted canonical phase space，在那里学习精确辛映射。框架不需要 recurrent latent、transformer decoder、隐式优化或推理时 ODE integration。对 physics-aware AI 来说，这篇提供了把几何守恒先验带进接触丰富机器人动力学预测的一种轻量方式。
methodHighlights: structured canonical lifts for driven, dissipative and constrained systems
exact symplectic maps in lifted phase space
out-of-distribution autoregressive prediction on pendulum, quadrotor and quadruped systems

papers.title: Flow-ERD: Agent-type Aware Flow Matching with Entropy-Regularized Distillation for Diverse Traffic Simulation
papers.authors: Seulbin Hwang, Kiyoung Om, Daejung Kim, Jinhan Lee
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.LG
papers.summary: Flow-ERD 面向自动驾驶交通仿真中的 realism-diversity tradeoff，避免只优化逼真度导致模式坍缩。它用 Agent-Type Aware Flow Matching 结合多模态表达能力和不同交通主体的运动执行约束，再用 entropy-regularized reverse-KL 蒸馏降低闭环 rollout 的分布偏移。论文用 log-free diversity metric 和标准 realism 指标一起评估，并报告在 WOSAC test benchmark 上表现突出。对闭环驾驶仿真，这篇强调多样性本身应成为优化目标。
methodHighlights: agent-type aware flow matching for multi-agent traffic simulation
entropy-regularized distillation to reduce covariate shift without mode collapse
joint realism-diversity evaluation for autonomous driving simulation

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-08
reports.summary: 2026-07-08 官方 arXiv 批次主体 32 篇，聚焦 4D world model/VLA、3D 场景理解与生成、3DGS/SLAM、HOI 和 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天最强的信号是 world model 与 VLA 开始向 4D/3D 物理表征靠拢：RynnWorld-4D、Lift3D-VLA、MECo-WAM、RynnWorld-Teleop 都在把几何、动作和未来预测绑定起来，而不是只做视觉上合理的视频生成。
实时/交互式 world model 也明显升温：MoWorld 强调低成本高帧率部署，AlayaWorld 强调可游玩的长时交互世界，Image2Sim 则把 RGB-D 扫描变成具身导航模拟器。它们共同指向一个趋势：world model 正在变成机器人和仿真的运行时组件。
三维场景理解从单房间、单任务走向长期和层级空间记忆：GEM-Occ 做 embodied semantic occupancy memory，CAIRN 做跨房间 topology-aware 3D-LLM，TRIG 和 Hilti-Trimble-Oxford 则分别强化自动驾驶/施工场景的度量几何和视觉惯性定位。
3DGS 的重心继续从“渲染质量”扩展到鲁棒性、语义和不确定性：SSA-3DGS 处理真实采集伪影，Bayesian 3DGS 提供 uncertainty/复杂度控制，GaussFusion 尝试把 Gaussian 表示预训练成多模态 3D token。
HOI 和 Physical AI 侧，SparseCtrl-HOI、WristMimic、ThorArena、LAMP 把注意力放在手-物接触、力、稀疏控制和人形机器人交互上；这说明三维视觉日报需要继续把 HOI 与普通 HCI 区分开，今天的 cs.HC 交叉条目只在与 world model/具身交互强相关时纳入。

papers.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Xingyue Zhao, Siteng Huang, Xin Li, Deli Zhao, Zhongyu Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: RynnWorld-4D 把机器人 world model 的表示从 2D 视频提升到同步 RGB、depth 和 optical flow 组成的 RGB-DF 4D 动态空间。论文的核心判断是，几何结构与时间运动需要一起预测，才更接近末端执行器动作所需的物理状态。方法通过 4D embodied world model 生成动作条件下的未来多模态观测，并将世界预测与策略学习之间的接口做得更低层、更具物理含义。对机器人操作而言，它值得优先看，因为它直接回答“世界模型预测什么表示才对控制有用”。
methodHighlights: RGB-DF multi-modal 4D world representation
action-conditioned 4D embodied world model
robot manipulation policy learning from physically grounded futures

papers.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
papers.authors: Jiaming Liu, Qingpo Wuwu, Nuowei Han, Hao Chen, Zhuoyang Liu, Fan Fei, Yueru Jia, Chenyang Gu, Yandong Guo, Boxin Shi, Shanghang Zhang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: Lift3D-VLA 针对现有 VLA 在三维几何和动态动作建模上的短板，显式把点云推理接入视觉-语言-动作模型。它强调物理环境中的操作泛化不能只靠 2D 图像 token，需要同时保留 3D 结构、空间关系和时间一致动作。论文报告覆盖 22 个仿真任务和 8 个真实任务，重点在“2D VLA 如何被提升到几何/动力学感知”的工程路径。对做 VLA 与三维感知融合的人，这篇是今日最直接相关的系统论文之一。
methodHighlights: explicit 3D point-cloud reasoning for VLA models
temporally coherent action generation
simulation and real-robot manipulation evaluation

papers.title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
papers.authors: Jianjun Zhang, Jian Zhu, Taiyi Su, Chong Ma, Zitai Huang, Yi Xu, Hanli Wang

papers.summary: 这篇提出 MECo-WAM，目标是在不显著增加推理成本的前提下，把动作相关的 4D 几何先验注入 World Action Model。作者认为现有 video-action co-training 容易学习外观 latent，而不是抓取、推动、接触等任务真正需要的时变几何。训练阶段引入视频专家、动作专家和轻量 4D 专家，推理阶段仍保持轻量图结构。它的价值在于把“几何监督只在训练时出现”作为一种实用的 Physical AI 设计。

4D geometric expert supervised by relational targets
geometry-enhanced training with lightweight inference graph

papers.title: RynnWorld-Teleop: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Digital Teleoperation
papers.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Xingyue Zhao, Hangyu Li, Biao Gong, Kehan Li, Siteng Huang, Xin Li, Deli Zhao, Zhongyu Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: RynnWorld-Teleop 把遥操作数据采集从真实机器人上解耦出来，让操作者用手部姿态流驱动生成式机器人中心 world model。模型从单张参考图合成高保真第一视角视频，同时记录可迁移到目标机器人的 pose/action 标签。这个设定把 world model 变成“数字遥操作环境”，用于缓解真实硬件、工作空间和人力时间的瓶颈。它和 RynnWorld-4D 形成互补：一篇强调 4D 状态表示，一篇强调数据规模化机制。
methodHighlights: digital teleoperation driven by hand-pose streams
action-conditioned egocentric video world model
embodiment-agnostic action labels for robot retargeting

papers.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
papers.authors: Zihan Wang, Seungjun Lee, Yinghao Xu, Gim Hee Lee
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: Image2Sim 面向具身导航的可扩展仿真环境问题，用 posed RGB-D 序列构建实时神经模拟器。它把 3D 空间锚定与 photorealistic observation synthesis 解耦，在保留真实扫描视觉质量的同时获得可交互环境。相比传统合成仿真，它更关注 sim-to-real 和物理锚定；相比真实扫描数据，它更强调可扩展和可 rollout。对导航、具身评测和世界模型训练数据构建都很有参考价值。
methodHighlights: real-time neural simulator from posed RGB-D sequences
decoupled 3D spatial anchoring and observation synthesis
scalable embodied navigation environments

papers.title: MoWorld: A Flash World Model
papers.authors: Team Moxin, Deyi Ji, Tianrun Chen, Xin Zhang, Jiale Yang, Qi Zhu, An Zhao, Zihao Xie, Han Wang, Xuanyi Liu, Yixiang Zhou, Pei Liu, Yi Tan, Cheng Chen, Dayi Zhu, Mingyu Wei, Hanjie Xu, Jun Liao, Siqi Li, Lingyu Lu, Hongye Fang, Hongming Tan, Youjiang Zhu, Taiyu Zhang, Zejian Li, Chaotao Ding, Lanyun Zhu, Yunhe Pan, Lingyun Sun

3D-native data engine with geometric consistency filtering
distillation and mixed-precision deployment for low-cost inference

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
papers.authors: AlayaWorld Team, Kaipeng Zhang, Chuanhao Li, Yifan Zhan, Yongtao Ge, Yuanyang Yin, Jiaming Tan, Kang He, Liaoyuan Fan, Ruicong Liu, Xiaojie Xu, Xuangeng Chu, Zhen Li, Zhengyuan Lin, Zhixiang Wang, Zian Meng, Zihui Gao
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.HC
papers.summary: AlayaWorld 讨论从视频 world model 构建可长时交互、可游玩的生成式世界。它把游戏录像和真实视频作为训练来源，让模型根据当前世界状态和用户动作自回归生成后续观测。论文的重点不是传统三维重建，而是把可控视频生成、实时交互和虚拟环境开发打通。它对具身智能的启发在于，world model 可以成为在线环境生成器，而不仅是离线预测器。
methodHighlights: full-stack framework for interactive generative worlds
long-horizon autoregressive video world generation
real-time user-conditioned playable environments

papers.title: GEM-Occ: From Visual Geometry Evidence to Embodied Semantic Occupancy Memory
papers.authors: Hu Zhu, Bohan Li, Xianda Guo, Hongsi Liu, Baorui Peng, Mingqi Yuan, Xin Jin, Wenjun Zeng, Chang Wen Chen
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: GEM-Occ 针对室内具身智能的长期空间记忆，构建层级化语义占用表示和 HIOcc benchmark。它把 ScanNet、ScanNet++、Matterport3D 统一为稀疏语义占用格式，同时保留 perspective RGB-D 与 pano-centric 观测几何。方法强调从视觉几何证据形成可持续更新的 embodied semantic occupancy memory，而不是只做单帧占用预测。对三维场景理解、导航和机器人长期记忆都值得优先阅读。
methodHighlights: hierarchical indoor semantic occupancy benchmark
unified sparse occupancy format across indoor datasets
embodied spatial memory from visual geometry evidence

papers.title: CAIRN: Cross-Room 3D Scene Understanding with Topology-Aware Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: He Liang, Chenyang Ma, Yiming Zhang, Sangyun Shin, Andrew Markham, Niki Trigoni, Yuhang He
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: CAIRN 面向真实家庭中的跨房间 3D 场景理解，指出现有 3D-LLM 多停留在单房间、简化对象集合上。它让 transformer attention 显式对齐对象级关系、房间级抽象和房间连通拓扑，并通过几何偏置的层级 attention mask 控制信息路由。作者还构建 CAIRN-MR benchmark，覆盖 grounding、captioning 和跨房间问答。arXiv 给出项目页，但本轮抓取该 GitHub Pages 地址返回 Site not found，需要后续复核。
methodHighlights: topology-aware 3D-LLM for multi-room scenes
object relation GNN and learned room tokens
CAIRN-MR benchmark on HM3D

papers.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
papers.authors: Tianjiao Yu, Xinzhuo Li, Yifan Shen, Onkar Susladkar, Yuanzhe Liu, Xiaona Zhou, Ismini Lourentzou
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.AI, cs.LG
papers.summary: ELSA3D 试图把 3D 生成与 3D 语言理解统一到同一 backbone 中，核心问题是文本和三维几何 token 的交互不能只是平铺自注意力。它提出 elastic semantic anchoring，用 scale-aware octree tokenizer 表示几何，再用 Anchor Tokens 在合适的三维尺度上检索和写回语义证据。模型同时面向 image-to-3D、text-to-3D 和 3D captioning，并强调更低 FLOPs 与更快推理。它是今日三维生成/理解统一方向的重点论文。
methodHighlights: elastic semantic anchoring between language and geometry
scale-aware octree tokenizer
unified image-to-3D, text-to-3D and 3D captioning

papers.title: SSA-3DGS: Unsupervised Removal of Screen-Space Artifacts for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Kristof Overdulve, Lode Jorissen, Nick Michiels
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.GR, cs.CV
papers.summary: SSA-3DGS 处理真实采集中常见但容易被 3DGS 烘进几何的 screen-space artifacts，例如水印、镜头污点、遮挡和传感器缺陷。论文把这些固定在二维图像平面的伪影与真实三维结构区分开，通过无监督方式减轻 floaters 和近相机错误高斯。它的应用场景很实际：真实数据越脏，3DGS 越需要这种 artifact-aware 训练。对把 3DGS 用到车载、户外和消费级采集的人优先级较高。
methodHighlights: unsupervised screen-space artifact removal
artifact-aware training for 3DGS
robust novel-view synthesis from imperfect captures

papers.title: Rendering-Aware Bayesian 3D Gaussian Splatting with Native Uncertainty and Adaptive Complexity Control
papers.authors: Gaoxiang Jia, Vikram Appia, Junzhou Huang, Xinlei Wang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.AI
papers.summary: 这篇把 Bayesian uncertainty 引入 3DGS，用渲染器派生的统计量跟踪高斯均值和协方差后验。目标是在 sparse-view 或固定采集预算下，知道哪些几何区域证据不足、哪些视角更值得补采。可选的 Dirichlet-process 扩展提供组件使用信号，用于复杂度控制。它的启发是，3DGS 系统化应用需要从“拟合快”走向“知道自己哪里不确定”。
methodHighlights: Normal-Inverse-Wishart posterior for Gaussian geometry
renderer-derived uncertainty summaries
adaptive complexity control and informative-view selection

papers.title: GaussFusion: Towards Multimodal 3D Gaussian Pretraining
papers.authors: Zhixuan You, Jihua Zhu, Yiding Sun, Zihao Guo, Haozhe Cheng, Dongxu Zhang, Lin Chen, Hainan Luo
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: GaussFusion 把 3D Gaussian 表示当作可预训练的显式 3D foundation representation。相比只做 masked Gaussian reconstruction，它引入图像和文本监督，通过跨模态语义对齐让 Gaussian encoder 同时学习局部结构和语言级语义。这个方向很关键，因为 3DGS 正从渲染表示转向可被检测、理解、检索和生成模型复用的通用 3D token。它适合关注 3D 表征预训练的人优先阅读。
methodHighlights: multimodal pre-training for 3D Gaussian representations
masked Gaussian modeling with image-text alignment
semantic Gaussian encoder for downstream 3D tasks

papers.title: APVI-SLAM: Real-Time Acoustic-Pressure-Visual-Inertial Localization and Photorealistic Mapping System in Complex Underwater Environment
papers.authors: Hanwen Zhang, Yipeng Zhu, Xiaopeng Guo, Huajian Huang, Sai-Kit Yeung

methodHighlights: acoustic-pressure-visual-inertial fusion
reliability-aware estimator reweighting
real-time localization with photorealistic mapping

papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO

floor plan priors for localization
dataset and challenge code release

papers.summary: TRIG 针对自动驾驶多相机系统中的 metric geometry 学习，把时变 ego trajectory 与静态 camera-rig geometry 解耦。现有视觉几何模型常把相机位姿编码为纠缠表示，难以利用车端刚性相机架的先验。TRIG 的价值在于把车辆多相机 rig 当作结构化几何对象，而不是普通多视角输入。对自动驾驶中的深度、位姿和 3D 重建联合学习很值得关注。

metric depth, pose and 3D reconstruction learning
vehicle-side geometric priors for autonomous driving

papers.title: SparseCtrl-HOI: Sparse Temporal Control for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
papers.authors: Shenbo Xie, Mingrui Cai, Xu Yang, Yifei Liu, Changxing Ding
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: SparseCtrl-HOI 研究 human-object interaction 视频生成，重点是用稀疏时间控制替代逐帧手-物姿态监督。论文指出 HOI 的难点在于手、物体和接触动态的细粒度时空协调，密集控制会带来高标注成本并限制动作多样性。SparseCtrl-HOI 试图只给关键时间点或稀疏控制信号，也能生成连贯的操作过程。它属于今日 HOI/手物交互方向最明确的条目。

reduced dependence on frame-wise hand-object pose guidance
spatio-temporal coordination for interaction synthesis

papers.title: WristMimic: Full-Body Humanoid Control with Wrist-Guided Manipulation

separation of contact-free body motion and contact-rich finger behavior
retargeting HOI demonstrations to physics simulation

human motion-force demonstrations
evaluation beyond kinematic imitation

methodHighlights: physically validated grasp quality annotations
large-scale Isaac Sim slip-test pipeline
hard negatives for SE(3) grasp pose generation

papers.title: FORGE: Towards Functional Tool-Use Generalization via Keypoint Trajectory Reasoning
papers.authors: Chuhao Zhou, Liquan Wang, Shuxin Cao, Xiangyu Chen, Yuxuan Hu, Boyu Ma, Animesh Garg, Jianfei Yang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CV

keypoint trajectory reasoning as intermediate representation
bridging visual function and executable actions

papers.title: LAMP: Latent Motion Prior-Guided Real-World Learning for Dexterous Hand Manipulation

papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO

safe exploration for high-dimensional dexterous hands
three-stage real-world dexterous learning pipeline

papers.title: UniLM-Nav: A Unified Framework for Zero-Shot Last-Mile Navigation
papers.authors: Zhuofan Zhang, Tianxu Wang, Guoxi Zhang, Yixiong Lin, Xilin Wang, Hongming Xu, Qing Li, Song-Chun Zhu, Lifeng Fan
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO

task-conditioned affordance grounding

papers.title: RoboTALES: Learning Reasoning-Guided Robot Policies via Task-Aligned Simulated Futures

papers.title: Imagined Rollouts are Kinematic, Not Dynamic: A Diagnosis of Long-Horizon World-Model Failure

taxonomy across RL, video generation, robotics and Physical AI

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-07
reports.summary: 2026-07-07 官方 arXiv 批次主体 32 篇，聚焦 world model/VLA、3DGS、场景级 3D 生成与 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的最大密度在机器人 world model/VLA：GigaWorld-1、Worldscape-MoE、DynaWM、DREAMSTEER、TACO、KAM-WM、WSA1 都在回答同一个问题，即世界模型怎样从“会生成未来”变成“能评估、能纠偏、能驱动动作”。
Physical AI 的触觉和可变形物体线索明显升温：Deform360 给出大规模多视角触觉数据，TACO 把触觉 world model 用于 VLA post-training，Mask2Real-WM 用 mask dynamics 缩小灵巧手 sim-to-real gap。
3DGS 继续系统化：今天既有 VOP-GS、DP-GS、LiDAR-GS SLAM、PRISM3D 这类几何/建图强化，也有 GUSH3R、WildSplat、AdaptiveSplat、CGGS、DeGenseGS 这类前馈、动态、语义和生成式扩展。
三维生成从单资产走向场景级和 4D：SynCity 3000、SceneFrom3D、InSpace、MV-Forcing 分别覆盖 scene-scale diffusion、户外几何条件生成、室内结构化生成和长时多视角动态视频。
值得注意的是，今天没有把普通 HCI 纳入 HOI；入选条目均与三维视觉、具身交互、机器人或 Physical AI 有直接关联。

papers.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
papers.authors: Hongyu Li, Wanjia Fu, Xiaoyan Cong, Zekun Li, Binghao Huang, Hanxiao Jiang, Xintong He, Yiqing Liang, Rao Fu, Tao Lu, Srinath Sridhar, Kevin A. Smith, George Konidaris, Yunzhu Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: Deform360 直击可变形物体 world model 的数据短板：它用 41 个环绕视角相机和双手触觉夹爪记录 198 个日常物体、1,980 段交互和超过 215 小时观测。论文还提供 markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline，把局部接触形变和全局几何运动对齐到密集 3D 表示。它特别适合比较 2D 视频世界模型与 3D 粒子/几何世界模型的边界，也能直接支持可变形物体的机器人规划评测。

benchmark comparing 2D video world models and 3D particle models

papers.authors: GigaWorld Team, Angyuan Ma, Boyuan Wang, Bohan Li, Chaojun Ni, Guo Li, Guan Huang, Guosheng Zhao, Hao Li, Hengtao Li, Jingyu Liu, Jiwen Lu, Qiuping Deng, Tingdong Yu, Xuancheng Xu, Xinyu Zhou, Xiuwei Xu, Xinze Chen, Xiaofeng Wang, Xiaoyu Tian, Yang Wang, Yifan Chang, Yukun Zhou, Yun Ye, Zhenyu Wu, Zhanqian Wu, Zheng Zhu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 2 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: GigaWorld-1 把 world model 从“生成未来画面”推向“评估机器人策略”的基础设施。论文构建 WMBench，将真实遥操作数据、匹配的策略 rollout、动作编码和长时域评估统一起来，分析 7 类视频世界模型和 4 种动作表示。核心结论很清楚：视觉真实感不是最关键，长时域动作一致性、动作编码、记忆设计和面向评估的后训练更决定是否能替代真实 rollout。
methodHighlights: WMBench for world-model-based robot policy evaluation

papers.authors: Jianjie Fang, Yongyan Xu, Ziyou Wang, Chen Gao, Yuchao Huang, Zhaolu Wang, Rongze Tang, Mingyuan Jia, Baining Zhao, Weichen Zhang, Xin Zhang, Haisheng Su, Yu Shang, Wei Wu, Xinlei Chen, Yong Li

papers.summary: Worldscape-MoE 关注一个很现实的扩展问题：不同 world model 控制接口被割裂成相机轨迹、机器人动作、手部关节等孤立形式。它把这些异构控制看作对同一物理世界的不同约束，用 Diffusion Transformer 加 MoE 来共享世界动力学，同时保留控制专属专家。实验覆盖 locomotion、机器人操作和 egocentric hand control，强调异构监督可以互相增强而不是互相干扰。

papers.title: DREAMSTEER: Latent World Models Can Steer VLA Policies During Deployment Without Any Finetuning
papers.authors: Hanchen Cui, Sergio Arnaud, Arjun Majumdar, Daniel Dugas, Elie Aljalbout, Karthik Desingh, Krishna Murthy Jatavallabhula, Franziska Meier

single-view RGB-D robust manipulation policies

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-06
reports.summary: 运行时 arXiv 尚未发布 2026-07-06 新批次；使用最近可用 2026-07-03 官方批次，主体 31 篇、补充 0 篇。
trends: 今日最突出的主线是 world model 和 world-action model 进一步三维化、物理化：PhysMani、ACID、VT-WAM、Bridge-WA、WorldSample 都在把未来预测与机器人动作可执行性、触觉/接触、物理约束连接起来。
3D Gaussian Splatting 继续从渲染表示向可编辑、可评测、可用于 SLAM/语义占用的系统表示扩展：PixGS、DL-SLAM、Semantic Occupancy、Mind the Gap、AnchorSplat、MVFusion-GS 和 Structure-Aware GS 分别覆盖生成、动态建图、开放词表空间理解、benchmark 缺陷和资产修复。
4D/场景生成今天很密集：Align4D、Unified Panoramic-Gaussian、WorldDirector、SimWorlds、SPG-Layout、InvSplat、PointDiT 都指向一个共同目标，即从单图/单目/文本/任意模态得到可探索、可编辑、几何一致的动态三维世界。
人-物/手-物交互和 articulated objects 也有明显进展：JointHOI 用接触图约束 HOI 生成，ComplexMimic 把人-场景交互放进物理仿真，PWM-ArtGen/SAMoR 则补 articulated object 的结构和运动先验。
VLA 方向更强调数据与视角策略：LIME、VLAFlow、The Moving Eye、TAP 说明 embodied AI 不只是学动作头，还要学何时移动相机、怎样构造数据、如何把物理运动能力与语言任务对齐。

self-supervised inverse dynamics from unlabeled interaction data
lightweight language grounding with limited expert demonstrations

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-03
reports.summary: 今日主体 31 篇、补充 0 篇；重点是物理化 3D world/action models、3DGS 生成/SLAM/语义占用与评测、4D/场景生成、HOI/articulated objects，以及 VLA 数据和视角策略。
trends: 今日最突出的主线是 world model 和 world-action model 进一步三维化、物理化：PhysMani、ACID、VT-WAM、Bridge-WA、WorldSample 都在把未来预测与机器人动作可执行性、触觉/接触、物理约束连接起来。
3D Gaussian Splatting 继续从渲染表示向可编辑、可评测、可用于 SLAM/语义占用的系统表示扩展：PixGS、DL-SLAM、Semantic Occupancy、Mind the Gap、AnchorSplat、MVFusion-GS 和 Structure-Aware GS 分别覆盖生成、动态建图、开放词表空间理解、benchmark 缺陷和资产修复。
4D/场景生成今天很密集：Align4D、Unified Panoramic-Gaussian、WorldDirector、SimWorlds、SPG-Layout、InvSplat、PointDiT 都指向一个共同目标，即从单图/单目/文本/任意模态得到可探索、可编辑、几何一致的动态三维世界。
人-物/手-物交互和 articulated objects 也有明显进展：JointHOI 用接触图约束 HOI 生成，ComplexMimic 把人-场景交互放进物理仿真，PWM-ArtGen/SAMoR 则补 articulated object 的结构和运动先验。
VLA 方向更强调数据与视角策略：LIME、VLAFlow、The Moving Eye、TAP 说明 embodied AI 不只是学动作头，还要学何时移动相机、怎样构造数据、如何把物理运动能力与语言任务对齐。

papers.title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
papers.authors: Peng Yun , Shouwang Huang , Hao Li , Jinxi Li , Jianan Wang , Bo Yang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 2 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-03 (Friday, 3 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.CV, cs.LG
papers.summary: PhysMani 面向动态目标操作，把机器人 world model 明确放到三维和物理约束里，而不是只预测未来视频。它用 3D Gaussian 表示场景，并学习 divergence-free Gaussian velocity field 来预测快速运动物体，再把预测交给 future-aware action policy。对 Physical AI 的价值在于：3DGS 不只是可视化地图，也可以成为带物理结构的操作预测器。
methodHighlights: physics-principled 3D Gaussian world model
divergence-free Gaussian velocity field for dynamic objects
future-aware policy for contact-rich/dynamic manipulation

papers.title: ACID: Action Consistency via Inverse Dynamics for Planning with World Models
papers.authors: Gawon Seo , Dongwon Kim , Suha Kwak
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 2 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-03 (Friday, 3 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CV
papers.summary: ACID 关注用 action-conditioned world model 做 decision-time planning 时的“看起来能到达”和“动作上真的可执行”之间的落差。它用 inverse dynamics 检查候选 rollout 的中间状态转移是否与动作一致，而不只看终点是否接近目标。该思路对机器人规划很实用：世界模型评估函数需要惩罚不可实现的漂亮未来。
methodHighlights: inverse-dynamics action consistency for world-model planning
checks intermediate transition realizability
decision-time planner that discourages infeasible rollouts

papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 2 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-03 (Friday, 3 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO

future tactile deformation prediction
contact-gated action-visual-tactile attention guidance

controllable world simulation with unrestricted viewpoint exploration

methodHighlights: any-modal X-to-4D generation
object-distance alignment between video and multiview priors
motion-geometry joint alignment for coherent 4D outputs

avoids complex cascaded 3D generation pipelines
targets view consistency and scalable 3D asset synthesis

monocular video to unseen-region 4D synthesis
camera-conditioned video generation fused with 3DGS

methodHighlights: plain ViT diffusion transformer for monocular geometry
direct raw 3D point-map patch prediction

papers.title: DL-SLAM: Enabling High-Fidelity Gaussian Splatting SLAM in Dynamic Environments based on Dual-Level Probability

uses temporarily static objects as pose constraints

methodHighlights: pose-free 3D Gaussian scene understanding

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Standard 3DGS Evaluation Primarily Measures Near-Trajectory Interpolation
papers.authors: Gaoxiang Jia , Vikram Appia

methodHighlights: matched-count interpolation vs extrapolation protocol

methodHighlights: source-free 3D-native Gaussian refinement

detail synthesis without original multi-view images

dynamic Gaussian Splatting reconstruction
explicit motion awareness for deformation fields

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-02
reports.summary: 今日主体 33 篇、补充 0 篇；重点是 3D/4D world models、3DGS 机器人安全与语义接口、触觉/双臂操作、开放词表 3D scene graph 和可用 3D 资产生成。
trends: 今天最强主线是 world model 进一步三维化和可控化：World from Motion、3D Point World Models、Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model、Path Planning in Physically Viable World Models 都在把未来预测放进 3D/4D geometry、3DGS 或点云空间，而不是只预测像素。
3D Gaussian Splatting 继续从渲染表示转向机器人接口：FastBridge 用 3DGS 做安全过滤，DeWorldSG/NoPA/PairGS 把 Gaussian 表示用于语义图和开放词表分割，FlatMinGS/GADA/GaussianFusion 则补 sparse-view 泛化和多模态融合短板。
机器人操作方向强调长时程、接触和技能复用：ABot-M0.5、FurnitureVLA、H-Tac/TTP、Wake up for Touch! 和 ASPIRE 分别覆盖 world action model、双臂装配、触觉预训练、多模态对齐和自主技能发现。
3D 生成与资产管线关注从几何到可用资产的落地：Pano2World、Ink3D、Restore3D、Stitched Embeddings、SuperFlex 和 Linkify 共同指向多视角世界生成、复杂纹理、损坏修复、服装/装配结构和可解释 primitives。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-01
reports.summary: 今日主体 34 篇、补充 0 篇；重点是 simulation-ready 4D scenes、任务条件化 3DGS 地图、Gaussian ray tracing/editing、长程 world model 评测、触觉/人形机器人操作和 occupancy-guided driving simulation。
trends: 今日 3DGS 主线明显从“可看”转向“可维护、可物理编辑、可进入机器人闭环”：GaussLite 把 Gaussian map 的容量分给任务相关区域，Streaming Gaussian Encoding 维护 4D occupancy 的时序一致性，GRay/Editable Reflections/Intrinsic GS 则把 ray tracing、反射和 intrinsic decomposition 带回物理一致渲染。
世界模型方向集中在“长程稳定”和“可用于规划”：PDR 用可微 3DGS 预测视频动态，MemLearner 学习上下文记忆查询，WorldRoamBench 把 interactive world model 的评测推到长时程稳定性和交互物理，DVG-WM 则为机器人操作解耦高层视觉生成与低层接触动态。

机器人操作与 Physical AI 的重点是把几何、接触和安全接口显式化：3D HAMSTER 把 2D VLA 轨迹落成 3D metric guidance，UniTacVLA/RoboTacDex 强化触觉模态，OopsieVerse 把 damage-aware simulation 加进 household manipulation，Human-as-Humanoid 则继续扩展从人类视频学习人形机器人动作的路线。
自动驾驶和仿真数据生成继续把 3D/occupancy 作为控制骨架：Horizon3D 做远距 radar-camera 3D 感知，InfiniVerse 用 occupancy guidance 生成无边界城市场景，DriveWeaver 和 ForgeDrive 分别处理可控车辆插入与 visual-action world model 的误差级联。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-30
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 34 篇，补充 0 篇；3DGS 地图、具身世界模型和机器人几何接口最突出。
trends: 2026-06-30 官方公告批次里，3D Gaussian Splatting 从单纯 novel view synthesis 继续向可维护地图、语义可查询场景、动态 4D 表示和真实机器人闭环推进：L2D2-GS、KiloGS-SLAM、GaussDet、CubifyGS、MyGO-Splat、StereoGS、Graph-GSReg 和 VCS-SLAM 都在解决长期尺度、稀疏视图、语义一致和地图复用问题。
世界模型和仿真评测的主线更偏“可执行物理”：CrashTwin 用多智能体碰撞检验生成式世界模型是否遵守物理，ViPSim 把 visual space 与 parameter space 协同起来做长时程具身 rollout，OWMDrive 用 4D occupancy world model 为端到端驾驶规划提供未来先验。

机器人方向突出“几何接口进入策略”：VLK 用 3DGS 重建场景合成 humanoid loco-manipulation 监督，ZR-0 用 dense embodied chain-of-thought 对齐跨 embodiment VLA，OpenSPM、SPARK、Event-VLA、YOTO 和 DCGrasp 分别从空间记忆、锚点 keypoint、事件相机、触觉和距离场抓取补上低层几何约束。

HOI、手物交互和 articulated objects 也很密集：CoGS 与 IMU-HOI 强调人-物交互中的组件解耦和接触推理，EPIC-Contact/HOPformer 将 in-the-wild egocentric 手物接触标注推到 3D pose 层面，UnfoldArt 则把 text/image 到 articulated 3D object recovery 做成 agentic debate。
最值得优先深读的是 VLK、L2D2-GS、KiloGS-SLAM、ViPSim、GaussDet、CubifyGS、ZR-0、CoGS、CrashTwin、UnfoldArt 和 EPIC-Contact。它们的共同启发是：三维表示正在从“可看”走向“可问、可维护、可模拟、可规划、可接触”。

papers.authors: Yen-Jen Wang, Jiaman Li, Sirui Chen, Takara E. Truong, Pei Xu, Pieter Abbeel, Rocky Duan, Koushil Sreenath, Angjoo Kanazawa, Carmelo Sferrazza, Guanya Shi, Karen Liu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T17:59:55Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.RO/new, cs.AI/new, cs.GR/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.GR, eess.SY
papers.summary: VLK 针对 humanoid loco-manipulation 缺少“第一视角图像、语言指令、机器人可执行轨迹”同步数据的问题，用 3DGS 重建室内场景自动合成监督。系统在重建场景中生成导航与物体交互轨迹，再离线渲染 egocentric observations，得到 48K 条 vision-language-kinematics paired trajectories。训练出的策略预测短时程全身运动，再由 whole-body tracker 转成 Unitree G1 的真实动作。它的核心价值是把三维重建资产直接变成 humanoid policy learning 的数据引擎。
methodHighlights: 3DGS reconstructed metric indoor scenes for synthetic supervision
vision-language-kinematics trajectory generation without human intervention
whole-body tracker bridges predicted kinematics to physical humanoid actions

papers.title: L2D2-GS: Learning to Densify for Feedforward Dynamic Gaussian Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zetian Song, Chenming Wu, Junnan Liu, Chitian Sun, Liangliang He, Hangjun Ye, Jiaqi Zhang, Siwei Ma, Wen Gao
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-28T12:51:17Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new, cs.GR/new); categories: cs.CV, cs.GR
papers.summary: L2D2-GS 面向自动驾驶仿真和大规模世界建模中的动态城市环境重建，试图摆脱 per-scene 3DGS optimization 的高成本。它把 feed-forward reconstruction 改写为迭代优化和 densification 过程，而不是一次性回归所有 Gaussian 参数。自监督 densification policy 用全局重建收益作为局部 primitive 生成的奖励，几何正则则减少早期伪影导致的坏局部最优。论文在 PandaSet 和 Waymo 上强调更少 primitives 下的高保真与 zero-shot 泛化。
methodHighlights: self-supervised densification policy driven by reconstruction gains
iterative feed-forward optimization instead of one-shot Gaussian regression
geometric reparameterization regularizes early dynamic-scene artifacts

papers.title: Open-Vocabulary and Referring Segmentation for 3D Gaussians Using 2D Detectors
papers.authors: Jameel Hassan, Yasiru Ranasinghe, Vishal Patel
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T17:58:41Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇论文提出 GaussDet，把 3D Gaussian scene 的开放词汇分割从 dense CLIP distillation 转向多视角 2D detector 投票。方法先学习 Gaussian instance features，把场景拆成 3D instance groups，再渲染这些 group 并聚合来自 2D open-vocabulary/referring detectors 的语义证据。View-Aggregated Semantic Label Distribution 用多视角一致性抑制错误标签。对 Embodied AI 来说，它让 3DGS 地图能响应复杂 referring expression，而不只支持简单名词查询。
methodHighlights: 3D instance grouping over Gaussian primitives
multi-view semantic voting from 2D open-vocabulary detectors
zero-shot referring-expression grounding on 3DGS scenes

papers.title: Robust and Efficient Monocular 3D Gaussian SLAM for Kilometer-Scale Outdoor Scenes
papers.authors: Sicheng Yu, Dongxu Shen, Beizhen Zhao, Guanzhi Ding, Hao Wang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T15:12:18Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: KiloGS-SLAM 处理 monocular 3DGS SLAM 在公里级室外场景中的两个瓶颈：长程 pose tracking 脆弱和 Gaussian map 内存膨胀。它使用 motion-adaptive hybrid tracking，在 Essential matrix、PnP 和按需 foundation model rescue 之间切换。mapping 端引入 lifecycle-managed Gaussian strategy，用 chunk-based multi-view densification 与 pruning 控制冗余。它对机器人/自动驾驶部署很重要，因为它把 3DGS SLAM 拉到 10K+ frames 的真实规模。
methodHighlights: motion-adaptive hybrid tracking with E-matrix, PnP, and foundation-model rescue
lifecycle-managed Gaussian mapping with chunk densification and pruning
kilometer-scale monocular 3DGS SLAM on a single GPU

papers.title: RAGA: Real Time Ray Traced Gaussian Shadow Casting for 3DGS Avatar-Scene Interaction
papers.authors: Aymen Mir, Riza Alp Guler, Jian Wang, Peter Wonka, Bing Zhou, Gerard Pons-Moll
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-28T10:55:32Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: RAGA 关注 3DGS avatar 放入已有 3DGS scene 后的阴影物理合理性，尤其是多人和 avatar-object interaction。它不重建 mesh，而是在 Gaussian space 中对 shadow ray 做 exact ray-Gaussian line integral。为减少服装形变带来的 temporal variance，论文还设计 avatar proxy representation。CUDA 和 NVIDIA OptiX 实现约 50 FPS，说明 3DGS 动态交互不一定要退回 mesh 才能得到可信阴影。
methodHighlights: exact ray-Gaussian line integral for shadow weights
mesh-free shadow casting in Gaussian space
avatar proxy stabilizes shadows under animation deformation

papers.title: CubifyGS: Object-Centric 3D Gaussian Splatting for Lifelong Dynamic Scene Maintenance
papers.authors: Bohan Ren, Dianyi Yang, Shiyang Liu, Yu Gao, Jiadong Tang, Zhilin Lai, Yi Yang, Mengyin Fu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-27T04:00:55Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: CubifyGS 面向机器人长期场景维护中的刚体物体重排问题。它把 movable instances 建模为 reusable Gaussian assets，通过出现/消失检测、asset retrieval、刚体变换和 explicit pruning 更新地图，而不是对 primitive 被动重优化。事件触发的 adaptive optimization 只在受影响区域补几何空洞和局部 photometric mismatch。它的价值在于把 3DGS map 从一次性重建变成可维护的对象级资产库。
methodHighlights: object-level Gaussian assets for rearranged scenes
appearance/disappearance detection plus rigid asset retrieval
event-triggered adaptive optimization for local map repair

papers.title: DR-GS: Physically-Based Deformable and Relightable 2D Gaussians
papers.authors: Jiaxin Li, Tong Wu, Yi Wei, Tailin Wu, Li Zhang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-28T13:03:13Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new, cs.AI/new, cs.GR/new); categories: cs.CV, cs.AI, cs.GR
papers.summary: DR-GS 解决 GS deformable object 中 illumination baked into texture 和 post-reconstruction material editing 困难的问题。它把 physically-based inverse rendering、relighting 和 deformation-aware manipulation 统一到一个 Gaussian pipeline 中。通过显式解耦 geometry、illumination 和 material，系统可以在形变和光照变化下保持反射与高光一致。对可编辑 3D asset 生成而言，这篇把“可渲染”推进到“可改材质、可换光、可形变”。
methodHighlights: disentangled geometry, illumination, and material Gaussian representation
physically based inverse rendering for deformable objects
post-reconstruction relighting and material editing

papers.title: Occlusion-Robust Multi-Object Decoupling for Physics-Based Interaction
papers.authors: Xin Dong, Wenfeng Deng, Yansong Tang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-28T09:50:46Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇论文把多物体稀疏视角重建中的 occlusion coupling 视为 physics-based interaction 的前置障碍。方法以 3DGS 为基础，用 SAM2-trained segmentation field 得到粗实例划分，再用 joint SDS 结合 reference-view supervision、2D/3D diffusion priors 补全碎片几何。它还加入 intra-object 和 inter-object similarity 等 geometry-aware priors。输出是无需手工 mask 的 simulation-ready 多物体资产，可接 Material Point Method 做物理交互。
methodHighlights: mask-free sparse-view multi-object decoupling
joint SDS with 2D and 3D diffusion priors
simulation-ready object reconstruction for MPM interaction

papers.title: FastPano3D: Feed-Forward Indoor Panoramic 3D Reconstruction from a Single Image
papers.authors: Jianqiang Li, Liumei Zhang, Wenjia Guo, Tianlong Feng, Yongzhi Liao, Di Lu, Hanchi Ren, Jingjing Deng
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T14:23:12Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: FastPano3D 从单张 panoramic image 直接生成 renderable 3D Gaussian indoor scene。它针对 equirectangular projection distortion 和空间不均匀特征分布，设计 lightweight feature encoder、adaptive Gaussian sampling 和 point-cloud-guided refinement。相比需要多视图监督或 test-time optimization 的方法，它强调秒级前向推理，并报告可比 NeRF/3DGS 的渲染质量。它适合关注快速室内 digital twin 初始化的读者。
methodHighlights: single-panorama feed-forward Gaussian scene reconstruction
adaptive Gaussian sampling for equirectangular distortion
point-cloud-guided refinement without test-time optimization

papers.title: Training Vision-Language-Action Models with Dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought Supervision
papers.authors: Haoyang Li, Guanlin Li, Youhe Feng, Chen Zhao, Zhuoran Wang, Yang Li, Qizhe Wei, Shifeng Bao, Haitao Shen, Yihan Zhao, Tong Yang, Jing Zhang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T16:48:48Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.RO/new, cs.CV/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: ZR-0 认为跨 embodiment VLA 的低层动作空间差异很大，但 scene perception、object identification、task planning 和 sub-task decomposition 这些高层认知过程可共享。它用 dense Embodied Chain-of-Thought supervision 训练 2.6B end-to-end VLA，把预训练 VLM 的结构化推理和 DiT action expert 用 cross-attention 耦合。推理时可以跳过 ECoT generation，不牺牲性能。ProcCorpus-60M 覆盖约 1000 小时、400K+ trajectories，使这篇成为今天机器人策略数据规模最大的工作之一。
methodHighlights: dense ECoT supervision for cross-embodiment representation alignment
dual-stream VLM plus flow-matching action expert
ProcCorpus-60M with dense frame-level embodied reasoning annotations

papers.title: Learning Efficient 4D Gaussian Representations from Monocular Videos with Flow Splatting
papers.authors: Shengjun Zhang, Jinzhao Li, Xin Fei, Yueqi Duan
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T08:50:27Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Flow Splatting 处理 monocular video 动态 3D scene reconstruction 中训练慢、渲染慢和 per-frame 4D volume 内存大的问题。它给 4D Gaussian volume 加上 time-varying means/covariances，并构造 velocity field，使 conventional splatting 可以渲染 optical flow 来监督动态学习。核心是把 dense dynamic information 用 flow 形式直接接入 4DGS 优化。它适合动态场景、移动相机和低资源 4D 重建方向。
methodHighlights: velocity-field construction over time-varying 4D Gaussians
flow rendering supervises monocular dynamic reconstruction
efficient alternative to deformation-field or per-frame 4D-volume pipelines

papers.title: Scenes as Objects, Not Primitives: Instance-Structured 3D Tokenization from Unposed Views
papers.authors: Mijin Yoo, In Cho, Subin Jeon, Jiwoo Lee, Eunbyung Park, Seon Joo Kim
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-28T17:21:45Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new, cs.GR/new); categories: cs.CV, cs.GR
papers.summary: Instok3D 把 feed-forward 3D reconstruction 的输出从无结构 points/Gaussians 改成 instance-structured 3D token groups。每组 token 同时包含 instance token 和 anchor tokens，前者编码对象身份，后者编码局部几何与外观，并解码为 3D Gaussians。这样对象实例成为表示的原生接口，而不是后处理分割结果。对机器人、编辑和场景生成而言，这种 object-centric tokenization 比 primitive cloud 更可用。
methodHighlights: instance-structured 3D token groups from unposed multi-view images
two-level instance and anchor token factorization
object-centric Gaussian decoding for reconstruction, segmentation, and manipulation

papers.title: CoGS: Compositional Dynamic Human-Object Scenes Gaussian Splatting from Monocular Video
papers.authors: Jerrin Bright, John Zelek
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-27T09:10:22Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: CoGS 面向 monocular human-object interaction scene reconstruction，问题在于人、物体和背景共享像素但运动模型不同。它将视频拆成 articulated human、rigid object field 和 static scene field 三个协同分支，并用分阶段优化避免运动泄漏。human 分支借助 canonical prior 补全很少被观察到的区域，object 分支由估计轨迹驱动。相比一体化动态 radiance field，它更适合为机器人学习构建可解释 HOI 资产。
methodHighlights: compositional Gaussian branches for human, object, and static scene
six-stage optimization to prevent motion leakage
monocular human-object interaction reconstruction with articulated and rigid priors

papers.title: UniTriSplat: A Unified 3D Gaussian Splatting Framework with Uniform Spherical Rasterization for Universal Cameras
papers.authors: Yipeng Zhu, Huajian Huang, Tristan Braud, Sai-Kit Yeung
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T05:14:48Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: UniTriSplat 解决 3DGS 在 perspective、fisheye、omnidirectional 等异构相机上 rasterization 不一致的问题。它把 Gaussian splatting reformulate 到 unit sphere，并用 HEALPix 的 equal-area property 构建和输入角分辨率对齐的 spherical grid。forward rendering 和 gradient propagation 都在 spherical radian domain 中完成。对机器人全景相机和 VR/AR 多相机系统，它提供了更统一的 3DGS 基础设施。
methodHighlights: HEALPix-based uniform spherical rasterization
camera-agnostic Gaussian rendering and gradients
HEALPix-aware perceptual loss for full-FoV reconstruction

papers.title: OpenSPM: An Environment-Transferable Robotic Key Spatial Pose Memory and Closed-Loop High-Frequency Flow-Matching Action Generation Model
papers.authors: Iok Tong Lei, Qingchen Xie, Yifan Wang, Yap Ying Jie, Zhidong Deng
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T08:12:58Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: OpenSPM 针对开放环境 tabletop manipulation 中语义泛化和精确几何执行之间的断层。系统先用 semantically conditioned 3D perception 与 Kalman filtering 跟踪连续 6D poses，再从人类 demonstrations 中提取 object-centric key spatial poses 作为 transferable memory。推理时检索相关 spatial pose memory，并用 closed-loop high-frequency flow-matching action generation 执行动作。它不是端到端替换 VLA，而是把明确几何记忆接到物理执行层。
methodHighlights: semantically conditioned 3D pose tracking
transferable object-centric spatial pose memory from demonstrations
closed-loop high-frequency flow-matching action generation

papers.title: MyGO-Splat: Multi-Objective Closed-Loop Geometric Feedback for RGB-Only Gaussian SLAM
papers.authors: Fan Zhu, Ziyu Chen, Zhenjun Zhao, Zhisong Xu, Hui Zhu, Mingrui Li, Chunmao Jiang, Javier Civera
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T03:22:06Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: MyGO-Splat 关注 RGB-only Gaussian SLAM 的 scale ambiguity 和开环几何漂移。它从 Gaussian map 中 analytically rasterize pixel-wise depth 和 surface normals，让已优化地图反过来监督 camera pose optimization。Scale-aware adaptive alignment 将 foundation-model depth 投到全局 Gaussian space 中，形成自校正的 scale feedback。它与 KiloGS-SLAM 形成互补：一个强调公里级，一个强调闭环几何反馈。
methodHighlights: closed-loop depth and normal feedback from Gaussian maps
scale-aware adaptive alignment of monocular depth priors
multi-objective tracking and mapping correction for RGB-only SLAM

papers.title: Ground4D: Consistency-Aware 4D Reconstruction from Monocular Video
papers.authors: Qing Zhao, Weijian Deng, Pengxu Wei, Liang Lin
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-27T09:27:42Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Ground4D 处理单目视频学习 4D scene representation 时几何随时间漂移的问题。动态 3DGS 往往通过 photometric optimization 获得好渲染，但不显式保证跨时间的几何一致。论文引入 consistency-aware 约束来同时服务 dynamic novel-view synthesis 和 faithful geometry。它适合与 Flow Splatting 对读：一个从 flow 监督动态，一个强调长期几何一致。
methodHighlights: consistency-aware monocular 4D reconstruction
dynamic novel-view synthesis with geometry preservation
regularization against temporal drift in dynamic Gaussian scenes

papers.title: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Agent Dynamics in World Models
papers.authors: Tianjian Chen, Jiaqi Xie, Yuyang Hu, Zhenyang Li, Zihao Wang, Wenjun Zeng, Yixin Zhu, Siyuan Huang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-27T06:13:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new, cs.RO/new); categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇论文提出 CrashTwin，用多智能体碰撞场景评估 world model 的物理可信度，而不只看视觉真实度和语义对齐。论文指出生成式世界模型可能在 rare but safety-critical interactions 中生成看似合理但物理错误的 rollout。CrashTwin 结合可控碰撞数据、物理指标和从视频 rollout 提取 metric kinematics 的流程。它对自动驾驶、机器人仿真和 Physical AI 的意义是把 world model benchmark 拉回可验证物理。
methodHighlights: physics-grounded evaluation for multi-agent collision dynamics
CrashTwin dataset with controllable safety-critical interactions
metrics beyond visual fidelity for world-model rollouts

papers.title: ViPSim: Collaborating Visual and Parameter Spaces for Consistent Long-Horizon Embodied World Models
papers.authors: Longyu Chen, Heng Li, Wei Yang, Manqi Zhao, Dongsheng Jiang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-27T08:18:09Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new, cs.RO/new); categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: ViPSim 认为 embodied world models 的长时程不稳定来自低维动作与高维视频之间的 representation gap。它把 Visual Space 定义为显式空间先验域，包含 end-effector pose projection、camera perspective、depth-informed geometry 等；Parameter Space 则承载动作和物理/任务参数。两者协同减少 trajectory drift 和 robot-object interaction inconsistency。对 VLA evaluation 而言，它把世界模型从纯视频生成拉向 action-grounded simulator。
methodHighlights: collaboration between visual priors and low-dimensional parameter spaces
depth and end-effector spatial priors for long-horizon rollouts
embodied world model aimed at VLA evaluation

papers.title: Sequential Planning via Anchored Robotic Keypoints
papers.authors: Bryce Grant, Aryeh Rothenberg, Logan Senning, Zonghe Chua, Zach Patterson, Peng Wang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T17:48:01Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: SPARK 是 training-free neurosymbolic manipulation system，用 anchored robotic keypoints 做顺序规划。系统让一个 Gemini call 生成 typed behavior tree，低层 primitives 内含 motion、grasping 和 depth geometry；另一个调用用于提出多样 perception prompts。它在 LIBERO-PRO position/task cells 上显著超过反复重查 LLM 的 code-generation agent。值得关注的是，它把 LLM 预算从每步重规划转移到鲁棒 perception 和几何锚点。
methodHighlights: anchored robotic keypoints as stable manipulation references
typed behavior tree over reusable low-level primitives
training-free neurosymbolic planning with perception prompt alternatives

papers.title: StereoGS: Sparse-View 3D Gaussian Splatting via Stereo Priors
papers.authors: Wenhao Yuan, Yiyuan Ge, Deli Cai
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T16:45:57Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: StereoGS 处理 sparse-view 3DGS 容易过拟合和单目深度先验尺度不一致的问题。它在优化中构造 virtual stereo pairs，并用 foundation stereo model 做 Stereo Depth Regularization，从而引入 absolute scale 和 binocular-consistent structures。Gradient-Aware Opacity Decay 用来抑制冗余 primitives 和过拟合。对稀疏视图重建而言，这篇比单纯单目 depth prior 更强调跨视角尺度闭合。
methodHighlights: virtual stereo pairs for sparse-view 3DGS optimization
stereo depth regularization with absolute scale consistency
gradient-aware opacity decay to reduce overfitting

papers.title: Event-VLA: Action-Conditioned Event Fusion for Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.authors: Jiaxin Liu, Xun Xu, Zhenhao Zhang, Hanqing Wang, Ruiqi Chen, Shi Chang, Weiyu Guo, Laurent Kneip
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-28T13:19:11Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new, cs.RO/new); categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: Event-VLA 针对 VLA 在低照度、强光变化等 degraded RGB observation 下的鲁棒操作问题。它把 event streams 作为对 RGB 的 illumination-robust、motion-sensitive 补充，而不是简单把 event feature 丢进全局语义 token。方法引入 action-conditioned event fusion，使事件信息更贴近 manipulation action 所需的时空变化。它对真实机器人部署很实际：很多失败并不是语义问题，而是观测物理条件变差。
methodHighlights: event streams as illumination-robust VLA observations
action-conditioned event feature fusion
robust manipulation under degraded RGB visibility

papers.title: UnfoldArt: Zero-Shot Recovery of Full Articulated 3D Objects from Text or Image
papers.authors: Mohamed el amine boudjoghra, Ivan Laptev, Angela Dai
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T17:44:53Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: UnfoldArt 面向 text/image 到 articulated 3D objects 的 zero-shot recovery，目标是恢复结构、运动和被 articulation 暴露的隐藏几何。它使用 debate-driven agentic approach：高层 agents 用 VLM/video model 推理语义和运动，低层 agents 估计 articulation parameters 与 interaction points。两轮 structured debate 先利用全局 object priors，再细化局部几何和关节。对具身环境资产生成而言，这篇把“生成静态物体”推进到“生成可交互的 articulated object”。
methodHighlights: debate-driven agents for articulated object reasoning
joint recovery of hidden geometry, motion, and articulation parameters
zero-shot text-or-image input for interactive 3D assets

papers.title: Graph-GSReg: Leveraging 3D Scene Graphs for Gaussian Splatting Registration
papers.authors: Jaewon Lee, Mangyu Kong, Euntai Kim
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T04:58:44Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Graph-GSReg 关注多个 3DGS scenes 合并成统一 Gaussian representation 的注册问题。它不是直接在 Gaussian primitive 间找对应，也不是依赖昂贵 image-based refinement，而是从 3DGS 及其渲染图构建 3D scene graph。注册在高层语义和结构上下文图上进行，从而获得更全局一致的初始对齐。它适合长期地图管理和多段扫描拼接，是 3DGS 从 demo 到系统化地图的一块拼图。
methodHighlights: 3DGS registration reformulated as scene-graph registration
semantic and structural context above primitive-level matching
supports large-scale Gaussian map merging and management

papers.title: You Only Touch Once: 6-DoF Object Pose Estimation from Single Tactile Contact

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-29
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 26 篇，补充 0 篇；物理世界模型、结构化 3D 生成和机器人策略注入最突出。
trends: 2026-06-29 官方公告批次里，世界模型明显从“能生成视频”转向“能作为物理可用的模拟器”: PhysisForcing、P3Sim、DiM-WAM、CascadeOcc、Directing the World 和 MemoBench 都在处理动作条件、空间记忆、长期 rollout、物理一致性和诊断评测。
三维重建和生成继续走向结构化、可部署: HAT-4D 从单目视频恢复多物体 4D 交互，ReScene 面向仿真就绪室内场景，StructSplat 与 Structured-Li-GS 分别攻克无标定稀疏视图和 LiDAR 约束 3DGS，CoIn 把 2D inpainting 与 3DGS 双向闭环。
机器人方向的重点是显式结构注入策略: SimFoundry 用真实视频构建可编辑 digital twins，Direct Action-Head Injection 把 grounded 3D point 直接喂给动作头，SceneBot/CWI 用接触标签和组合模仿统一 humanoid loco-manipulation。
具身空间评测也在变细: AirGroundBench 评估 UAV-UGV 多视角协作，LocalNav 关注端侧 VLM 物体导航，LXD-SLAM 把多传感器 dense mapping 做成可插拔组合。
最值得优先深读的是 PhysisForcing、P3Sim、HAT-4D、SimFoundry、ReScene、StructSplat、DiM-WAM、DexCompose、CascadeOcc 和 Direct Action-Head Injection。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-26
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 25 篇，补充 0 篇；物理世界模型、3DGS 几何保护和接触式机器人操作最突出。
trends: 2026-06-26 官方新公告批次里，3D/4D 表示和世界模型明显向物理可控性靠拢: PhysiFormer、Neural Voxel Dynamics、PhysEditWorld、Fast LeWorldModel、DexAC-WM 和 Hallucination in World Models 都在处理动作、几何、物理状态与长期 rollout 的一致性问题。
3DGS/NeRF 方向的关键词是几何保护和可诊断: SatSplatDiff、PanoImager、SceneStyler、Vis4GS、RayPE 和 Sculpting NeRF Geometry 分别从卫星重建、稀疏全景、风格一致性、训练可解释、射线编码和偏好优化切入。
机器人操作的热点集中在接触和物理反馈: Play2Perfect、VibeAct、Tactile-WAM、PressMimic、RelAfford6D、SSI-Policy 和 Motion Feasibility from Point Clouds 都在把触觉、压力、点云、6D affordance 或阶段结构显式注入策略。
具身数据和评测继续向真实长时程移动: OctoSense、WatchAct、RobOralScan、OmniContact 和 E-TTS 分别补多模态传感、行为 grounding、主动三维扫描、HOI 式 humanoid loco-manipulation 与测试时扩展。

最值得优先深读的是 PhysiFormer、Neural Voxel Dynamics、PhysEditWorld、KRVF、RelAfford6D、VibeAct、Tactile-WAM、RayPE、PanoImager 和 Hallucination in World Models；它们对三维重建、世界模型和 Physical AI 的共同启发是: 仅有视觉逼真不够，模型必须把几何坐标、接触、物理参数、传感来源和数据覆盖显式纳入闭环。

papers.title: Tactile-WAM: Touch-Aware World Action Model with Tactile Asymmetric Attention

touch-aware attention bias improves contact-rich manipulation success

papers.title: SSI-Policy: Learning Structured Scene Interfaces for Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation

trainable from action-free video and robot-agnostic
improves low-demo LIBERO and real-world manipulation

pressure-derived contact/support constraints reduce kinematic ambiguity
pressure-supervised humanoid control improves stable contact execution

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-25
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 25 篇，补充 0 篇；VLA 动作先验、world modeling、3DGS/4D 表示和力觉操作最突出。
trends: 2026-06-25 最近公告批次里，3D 表示的重点不是再提出全新渲染原语，而是把 3DGS/4D proxy/对象 SLAM 变成可编辑、可控制、可部署的系统: TryOnCrafter、MVTrack4Gen、Support-Aware Appearance 和 DSP-SLAM++ 最有代表性。
机器人 VLA 正在从纯视觉-语言对齐转向显式动作先验、世界模型上下文和几何/空间 grounding: Learning Action Priors、ICWM、SVP-IL、WOLF-VLA、HALO 都在补 VLA 的物理执行短板。
Physical AI 线索很密集: ForceBand 用肌电补力觉示范，RigPI 用 VLM 初始化可微仿真参数识别，DeformGen 用动力学生成可变形物体增强，AISPO 把深度补全目标转向可抓取性。
导航和 SLAM 方向更强调语义地图与长期记忆: RoboAtlas、RAVEN、SAGE-Nav 和 fARfetch 都把 3D/空间结构放在 VLM/LLM 推理之前，避免只依赖语言模型临场猜测。

papers.title: Learning Action Priors for Cross-embodiment Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Dong Jing, Tianqi Zhang, Jiaqi Liu, Jinman Zhao, Zelong Sun, Li Erran Li, Zhiwu Lu, Mingyu Ding
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:59:56Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇论文指出，现有 VLA 往往直接在视觉-语言 backbone 后接动作模块，动作时间结构需要从零开始学，尤其在跨 embodiment 任务中收敛慢、数据效率低。作者先用未条件化动作轨迹预训练一个轻量 flow-matching encoder-decoder 动作模块，再把 decoder 和 latent distillation 迁移进 VLA 训练。训练好的 encoder 还能把状态-动作历史压成一个时间上下文 token，用极小代价支持 history-aware policy。结果显示，在 13 个仿真和真实跨 embodiment 任务上，动作先验带来更快收敛、更高成功率和更强低数据泛化。

flow-matching action module learns temporal motion structure from raw action trajectories
latent distillation and decoder reuse transfer the prior into cross-embodiment VLA policies

papers.title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
papers.authors: Siyin Wang, Junhao Shi, Senyu Fei, Zhaoyang Fu, Li Ji, Jingjing Gong, Xipeng Qiu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T16:53:36Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: ICWM 把机器人系统辨识改写成 in-context adaptation 问题，而不是每遇到新相机视角或机器人形态就重新微调。策略在执行任务前先观察一小段自生成、任务无关交互历史，从中推断当前系统的关键变量和动力学。这里的上下文不是告诉模型“做什么任务”，而是让模型理解“这个系统如何运作”。仿真和真实平台实验表明，这种 world modeling 上下文显著提升 VLA 对新视角和新配置的泛化。
methodHighlights: uses short self-generated interaction histories for in-context system identification
separates how-the-world-works context from task demonstrations
adapts robotic control to novel camera viewpoints and robot configurations without parameter updates

papers.title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
papers.authors: Alexander Schperberg, Shivam K. Panda, Abraham P. Vinod, M. K. Jawed, Stefano Di Cairano

contextual bandit balances geometric exploration and semantic navigation
large real-world deployment plus GOAT-Bench evaluation

papers.title: ForceBand: Learning Forceful Manipulation with sEMG
papers.authors: Botao He, Zhi Wang, Linna Kuang, Ishaan Ghosh, Jitendra Malik, Cornelia Fermuller, Tingfan Wu, Jiayuan Mao, Ruoshi Liu, Haozhi Qi, Yiannis Aloimonos
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:59:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO

force-augmented demonstrations improve manipulation requiring contact-force control

papers.title: TryOnCrafter: Unleashing Camera Trajectories for Realistic Video Virtual Try-on via a Renderable 4D Try-on Proxy

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-24
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 29 篇，补充 0 篇；3DGS/显式资产、几何 VLA、world-model value 和 physics-aware policy 最突出。
trends: 最新 2026-06-24 公告批次的三维视觉主线明显转向“可用资产和可交互表示”: ArtiTwinSplat、Pocket-SLAM、FLAT、FLUX3D、OrbitForge、3DCarGen 和 MM-TRELLIS 都在把 3DGS、triangle splats、mesh 或点云条件推向可渲染、可仿真、可部署的 3D 资产。
机器人方向的重点是让 VLA 和 diffusion policy 更接近真实物理约束: InSight 做自引导技能获取，G^3VLA 注入几何归纳偏置，NoContactNoWorries 和 TACTFUL 强调接触/触觉，Physics-Guided Diffusion Control 与 Cloth Sim-in-the-Loop 则把可行性校验和模拟器放到推理时。
世界模型继续从“预测视频”扩展为“规划和价值接口”: World Value Models 用 world model 估计机器人轨迹价值，NavWM 用视觉 foresight 做闭环导航，DynaWM 用 world model 约束运动表示。
3D 生成评估正在变严: GeoT2V-Bench 明确用重建诊断 text-to-video 的 3D 一致性，OrbitForge 也强调 coverage-aware evaluation，说明视觉逼真度已经不足以支撑 3D asset generation。

最值得优先深读的是 ArtiTwinSplat、InSight、FLAT、FLUX3D、OrbitForge、World Value Models、G^3VLA、NoContactNoWorries、NavWM 和 Pocket-SLAM；它们分别对应 articulated 3DGS digital twin、自主技能增长、显式表面生成、3DGS 原生生成、视频先验到 3D 场景、world-model value learning、几何 VLA、接触估计、导航 world model 和可扩展 3DGS-SLAM。
